# Semi Design System (@semi/ui v0.14.0)

> The shared UI of every Semi app: semantic tokens that work in light and dark mode, React components (Next.js, Tailwind CSS 4) and the rules agents follow. Every component has a page with live examples and a markdown twin for agents.

Install `@semi/ui`, import components from `@semi/ui`, class constants from `@semi/ui/styles`, CSS `@semi/ui/tokens.css` + `@semi/ui/base.css`. Before writing UI read QUICK_REF.md; pick the component from docs/components/README.md, read its page, copy an example; never invent local colours, sizes or wrapper components; check with `npx semi-lint`.

In a project with the package installed, ask the docs instead of reading files: `npx semi search "<need in words>"`, `npx semi docs <Component>`, `npx semi example <id>`, `npx semi add <block>` (dashboard, list-page, settings-page, agent-run), or `npx semi mcp` as an MCP server (tools semi_search, semi_docs, semi_example, semi_props, semi_list, semi_block; the semi-design plugin starts it). Guide: docs/AGENT_TOOLS.md.

## Machine-readable

- [components.json](./components.json): all 121 components, hooks and constants with props, summaries and their doc page
- [docs/components/README.md](./docs/components/README.md): every component doc by group, with when to use it
- [QUICK_REF.md](./docs/QUICK_REF.md): Quick reference: the rules and imports to read before any UI change
- [DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](./docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md): Full design system rules (layout, colour, components, accessibility, anti-patterns)
- [COMPONENT_DOCS.md](./docs/COMPONENT_DOCS.md): How the component docs are built (examples/, meta.json, generated API) and how agents should use them
- [AGENT_TOOLS.md](./docs/AGENT_TOOLS.md): Agent tools: the semi CLI (search, docs, example, add) and the MCP server, and the page blocks
- [ICONS.md](./docs/ICONS.md): Semantic icon guide: which icon means what
- [BRANDS.md](./docs/BRANDS.md): Brands: brand kits (brand.json → brand.css), the step-by-step flow from a new brand to its first product, which command when
- [STYLES.md](./docs/STYLES.md): Styles (Flat, Soft, Sharp): what each changes, how an app picks one
- [agent-rules.md](./docs/agent-rules.md): Rules block for a consumer app's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
- [tokens.css](./docs/tokens.css): Generated design tokens (CSS variables for both themes)
- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): this file followed by all the docs above and every component doc

## Pages

- [Introduction](./): what Semi is, install, resources for agents
- [Components](./components/): every component with a live example
- [Foundations](./foundations/): surface tokens, type scale, icon registry
- [Brand preview](./brand/): preview a brand on every page before creating its kit

## Components

### Actions

- [Button](./components/button/) ([markdown](./docs/components/button.md)): The action control: one primary per area, secondary for the rest, danger for destructive actions, ghost for quiet ones. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it. Components: Button, Spinner.
- [Button group](./components/button-group/) ([markdown](./docs/components/button-group.md)): Joins related buttons into one segmented control: shared borders, outer corners only (‹ Hôm nay ›, Lưu | ▾). Components: ButtonGroup.
- [Chip](./components/chip/) ([markdown](./docs/components/chip.md)): A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags. Neutral when off; active uses the high-contrast surface, with colour only on its dot or icon (tone). Components: Chip.
- [External link](./components/external-link/) ([markdown](./docs/components/external-link.md)): A link to another site: opens a new tab on desktop and the external browser inside a mobile WebView, with an external-link icon. Components: ExternalLink.
- [Pills](./components/pills/) ([markdown](./docs/components/pills.md)): A single-choice filter of 2–5 options on one track (segmented look). The left side of a SubpageToolbar. Components: Pills.
- [Toggle](./components/toggle/) ([markdown](./docs/components/toggle.md)): Buttons that stay pressed. Toggle for one (pin, mute, bold); ToggleGroup for a set of icon or short options, one or several at a time (list / grid view, text styles). Components: Toggle, ToggleGroup.

### Forms

- [Calendar](./components/calendar/) ([markdown](./docs/components/calendar.md)): A month grid to pick one day or a range (YYYY-MM-DD, weeks start on Monday). DatePicker shows it in a popover; place it inline for schedules and report filters. Components: Calendar.
- [Checkbox](./components/checkbox/) ([markdown](./docs/components/checkbox.md)): A native checkbox with label and description, checked fill in the accent, and an indeterminate state for “select all”. Components: Checkbox.
- [Combobox](./components/combobox/) ([markdown](./docs/components/combobox.md)): CustomCombobox: type to filter a long list, then pick one value. Components: CustomCombobox.
- [Date picker](./components/date-picker/) ([markdown](./docs/components/date-picker.md)): A date field with a Calendar popover (YYYY-MM-DD, min / max). Never type="date". Components: DatePicker.
- [Field, Input, Textarea](./components/field/) ([markdown](./docs/components/field.md)): Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field). Components: Field, Input, Textarea.
- [Input group](./components/input-group/) ([markdown](./docs/components/input-group.md)): An input with fixed parts around it: a prefix (https://), a unit (kg, ₫), an icon or a small button (copy, show password). Components: InputGroup.
- [Input OTP](./components/input-otp/) ([markdown](./docs/components/input-otp.md)): One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, SMS autofill, screen readers and the number keypad work like a normal field. Components: InputOTP.
- [Number input](./components/number-input/) ([markdown](./docs/components/number-input.md)): NumberInput: numbers with a touch keypad (NumPadPopup) on phones and tablets, plain typing elsewhere. Never type="number". Components: NumberInput, NumPadPopup.
- [Radio group](./components/radio-group/) ([markdown](./docs/components/radio-group.md)): Exactly one option of a few, each with an optional description; vertical by default. Components: RadioGroup.
- [Search input](./components/search-input/) ([markdown](./docs/components/search-input.md)): The toolbar search: an icon button that opens into a field (clear button, h-control); it collapses again when empty and focus leaves. SubpageToolbar includes one. Components: SearchInput.
- [Select](./components/select/) ([markdown](./docs/components/select.md)): CustomSelect: pick one value from a list, in a field, in a toolbar, inline in a row or bare. Never the native <select>. Components: CustomSelect.
- [Slider](./components/slider/) ([markdown](./docs/components/slider.md)): Pick a number in a range by dragging: one thumb, or two with range for a min–max pair. Components: Slider.
- [Switch](./components/switch/) ([markdown](./docs/components/switch.md)): An on / off toggle for settings that apply immediately. Components: Switch.

### Overlays

- [Command](./components/command/) ([markdown](./docs/components/command.md)): A command palette: type to filter actions and pages, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to run. Command is the inline list; CommandDialog opens it over the page, usually on ⌘K (useHotkey). Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks. Components: Command, CommandDialog.
- [Confirm dialog](./components/confirm-dialog/) ([markdown](./docs/components/confirm-dialog.md)): confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false. Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm. Components: ConfirmHost.
- [Context menu](./components/context-menu/) ([markdown](./docs/components/context-menu.md)): The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus. Components: ContextMenu.
- [Drawer](./components/drawer/) ([markdown](./docs/components/drawer.md)): A panel that slides in from the right, left, bottom or top (a sheet), with title and footer. Components: Drawer.
- [Hover card](./components/hover-card/) ([markdown](./docs/components/hover-card.md)): A preview card while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, a link: a person, a product, an order. Components: HoverCard.
- [Menu](./components/menu/) ([markdown](./docs/components/menu.md)): The overflow menu of a row or card: a ⋯ trigger (or your own) with items, icons, separators and a danger item last. Components: Menu.
- [Modal](./components/modal/) ([markdown](./docs/components/modal.md)): The shared dialog: full screen on phones, a centred panel from sm up, with title, description, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener. Components: Modal.
- [Popover](./components/popover/) ([markdown](./docs/components/popover.md)): A small non-modal panel under its trigger for interactive content: a quick form, filters, a picker. Components: Popover.
- [Toast](./components/toast/) ([markdown](./docs/components/toast.md)): toast() shows a short message after an action, with a tone and an optional action (Hoàn tác). Mount ToastHost once in the root layout. Components: ToastHost.
- [Tooltip](./components/tooltip/) ([markdown](./docs/components/tooltip.md)): A short label on hover or focus, mostly for icon-only buttons. Components: Tooltip.

### Navigation & layout

- [App header](./components/app-header/) ([markdown](./docs/components/app-header.md)): The top bar of a stand-alone tool app: logo + title go home, the module name, and one primary action on the right. No Home button. Components: AppHeader.
- [App shell](./components/app-shell/) ([markdown](./docs/components/app-shell.md)): The frame of a multi-page app: a floating bento sidebar (w-52, collapses to a w-14 icon rail) on bg-canvas, the content panel beside it, and MobileTabBar at the bottom on phones. This docs site is an AppShell. Components: AppShell, MobileTabBar.
- [Breadcrumb](./components/breadcrumb/) ([markdown](./docs/components/breadcrumb.md)): Where the page sits: a trail of links ending with the current page. Long trails collapse their middle into a “…” menu. Components: Breadcrumb.
- [Menubar](./components/menubar/) ([markdown](./docs/components/menubar.md)): The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): menus that open from a bar and behave like Menu. Components: Menubar.
- [Navigation menu](./components/navigation-menu/) ([markdown](./docs/components/navigation-menu.md)): Top navigation of a website or landing page: links, and items that open a panel of links with descriptions. Below md it becomes one menu button with a sheet. Components: NavigationMenu.
- [Page actions](./components/page-actions/) ([markdown](./docs/components/page-actions.md)): Lets a page put its actions into a slot of the shared header: PageActionsProvider wraps the layout, PageActionsSlot marks where they render, PageActions sends them from the page. Components: PageActions, PageActionsProvider, PageActionsSlot.
- [Page title](./components/page-title/) ([markdown](./docs/components/page-title.md)): PageTitle is the large display title of a page (text only). PageTabsTitle turns it into 2–4 underline tabs for sibling pages. Components: PageTitle, PageTabsTitle.
- [Pagination](./components/pagination/) ([markdown](./docs/components/pagination.md)): Page numbers with previous / next for long tables. For card lists prefer auto-loading with “Xem thêm”. Components: Pagination.
- [Resizable panels](./components/resizable/) ([markdown](./docs/components/resizable.md)): Panels side by side or stacked with handles to resize them (an editor beside a preview, a list beside details). Sizes are percentages and can be remembered. Components: ResizablePanels.
- [Scroll area](./components/scroll-area/) ([markdown](./docs/components/scroll-area.md)): A fixed-size scrolling region (a long list in a card, a log). Semi hides scrollbars, so it marks the edges that have more content, can show a thin scrollbar, and is reachable by keyboard. Components: ScrollArea.
- [Side panel](./components/side-panel/) ([markdown](./docs/components/side-panel.md)): A 320px tool panel beside a canvas that collapses to a 48px rail; SidePanelToggle is its collapse button. Components: SidePanel, SidePanelToggle.
- [Subpage toolbar](./components/subpage-toolbar/) ([markdown](./docs/components/subpage-toolbar.md)): The sticky row under a page title: filters on the left; search, refresh and the icon-only primary action on the right. RefreshButton spins while its promise runs. Components: SubpageToolbar, RefreshButton.
- [Tabs](./components/tabs/) ([markdown](./docs/components/tabs.md)): Switch between panels of content inside a page or card: underline (default) or segmented, with icons and counts. Components: Tabs.

### Data display

- [Accordion](./components/accordion/) ([markdown](./docs/components/accordion.md)): A list of sections where one (or several) open at a time: FAQs, settings groups, help. Components: Accordion.
- [Aspect ratio](./components/aspect-ratio/) ([markdown](./docs/components/aspect-ratio.md)): Keeps media at a fixed ratio while its width follows the layout (images, video, maps, 3D previews). Components: AspectRatio.
- [Avatar](./components/avatar/) ([markdown](./docs/components/avatar.md)): A person or team: their image, or initials on a tone picked from the name. Components: Avatar.
- [Badge](./components/badge/) ([markdown](./docs/components/badge.md)): A read-only status or tag in a tone (10% fill, 20% border, theme-safe text), with an optional dot or icon. Components: Badge.
- [Card](./components/card/) ([markdown](./docs/components/card.md)): The bento content card: panel fill and the style's card border, radius and resting shadow. interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item. Components: Card.
- [Carousel](./components/carousel/) ([markdown](./docs/components/carousel.md)): Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrow keys, buttons or dots (CSS scroll-snap, no library). Phones show one slide and a peek of the next. Components: Carousel.
- [Chart](./components/chart/) ([markdown](./docs/components/chart.md)): Charts in SVG on Semi tokens, no library: BarChart (grouped or stacked columns), LineChart (optional area wash), DonutChart (parts of a whole) and Sparkline (a trend in a tile). Series use the fixed chart-1…8 colours (validated for colour-blind readers in both themes); every chart has a legend for 2+ series, a hover / keyboard tooltip and a table view. Components: BarChart, LineChart, DonutChart, Sparkline.
- [Code block](./components/code-block/) ([markdown](./docs/components/code-block.md)): Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button and an optional title (file name); long lines scroll sideways. Plain text, no highlighting. Components: CodeBlock.
- [Collapsible](./components/collapsible/) ([markdown](./docs/components/collapsible.md)): One section that opens and closes under its trigger row (advanced options, details of a log line). Components: Collapsible.
- [Data table](./components/data-table/) ([markdown](./docs/components/data-table.md)): A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it). Components: DataTable.
- [Icon](./components/icon/) ([markdown](./docs/components/icon.md)): The semantic icon registry (stroke 1.75, 24px grid). IconTile is the rounded tinted square that leads cards and dialogs. Components: Icon, IconTile.
- [Item](./components/item/) ([markdown](./docs/components/item.md)): A list row — leading icon / avatar / image, title and description, meta on the right, actions — and ItemGroup, which stacks rows in a card with dividers. Components: Item, ItemGroup.
- [Kbd](./components/kbd/) ([markdown](./docs/components/kbd.md)): A key or a shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) as key caps, for menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text. Components: Kbd.
- [KPI card](./components/kpi-card/) ([markdown](./docs/components/kpi-card.md)): A metric card: label, a large tabular figure, a sub line coloured good / danger, and an icon in its tone. Components: KpiCard.
- [Markdown](./components/markdown/) ([markdown](./docs/components/markdown.md)): Renders AI or user text safely: paragraphs, lists, bold, inline code and links (as ExternalLink). No HTML. Components: Markdown.
- [Separator](./components/separator/) ([markdown](./docs/components/separator.md)): A thin divider between groups of content: horizontal, vertical, or with a short label in the middle (“hoặc”). Components: Separator.
- [Table](./components/table/) ([markdown](./docs/components/table.md)): A dense table for rows compared column by column. Cells stay on one line (the table scrolls sideways on phones); TD wrap for a long-text column, numeric for figures. Components: Table, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD.
- [Typography](./components/typography/) ([markdown](./docs/components/typography.md)): The type scale (text-caption 11 … text-display 26, font-display for titles) and Prose, which styles long-form text — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code — from that scale. Components: Prose.

### Feedback

- [Alert](./components/alert/) ([markdown](./docs/components/alert.md)): A message that stays on the page: info, success, warning, danger, with a title, an action and an optional dismiss. Components: Alert.
- [Empty state](./components/empty-state/) ([markdown](./docs/components/empty-state.md)): What an empty list or page shows: an icon, one short title, a description and the action that fills it. Components: EmptyState.
- [Progress](./components/progress/) ([markdown](./docs/components/progress.md)): A determinate bar with value, or an indeterminate one when the end is unknown; tones for success and danger. Components: Progress.
- [Skeleton](./components/skeleton/) ([markdown](./docs/components/skeleton.md)): Shimmer placeholders while content loads: Skeleton blocks, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton; Loading announces the region. Never “Đang tải…” text. Components: Skeleton, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton, Loading.

### AI

- [Action confirmation](./components/action-confirmation/) ([markdown](./docs/components/action-confirmation.md)): An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send, delete, pay, run a command): what it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; the outcome replaces the buttons once decided. Components: ActionConfirmation.
- [AI chat](./components/ai-chat/) ([markdown](./docs/components/ai-chat.md)): AIChat is the ready-made assistant panel: ChatPanel (side panel or full screen, resizable, keyboard inset) around ChatView (list + composer). UI only: the app keeps the messages, streams the answer and calls the model. Components: AIChat, ChatPanel, ChatView.
- [Chat messages](./components/chat-messages/) ([markdown](./docs/components/chat-messages.md)): The parts of a conversation, to compose your own chat: UserMessage, AssistantMessage (+ ChatAnswer for a ChatItem), ChatThinking, ChatError, ChatCopyButton, ChatAvatar, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion(s), ChatList and ChatComposer. Components: UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ChatAnswer, ChatAvatar, ChatCopyButton, ChatError, ChatThinking, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion, ChatSuggestions, ChatList, ChatComposer.
- [Chat model picker](./components/chat-model-picker/) ([markdown](./docs/components/chat-model-picker.md)): Provider → model → effort chips, for the toolbar of a chat composer. The lists are app data. Components: ChatModelPicker.
- [Context meter](./components/context-meter/) ([markdown](./docs/components/context-meter.md)): How full the model's context window is: a small ring with the percent, token counts in a tooltip; amber from 80%, red from 95%. Components: ContextMeter.
- [File tree](./components/file-tree/) ([markdown](./docs/components/file-tree.md)): Files and folders as a keyboard tree, with A / M / D marks for what an agent added, modified or deleted; select a file to open it. Components: FileTree.
- [Reasoning](./components/reasoning/) ([markdown](./docs/components/reasoning.md)): The model's reasoning above its answer: open while it streams, folded to “Đã suy luận trong N giây” when done, reopenable. Components: Reasoning.
- [Sources](./components/sources/) ([markdown](./docs/components/sources.md)): Where an answer came from: Citation marks inside the text (numbered, linked) and a Sources list under the answer that opens to the pages. Components: Sources, Citation.
- [Task list](./components/task-list/) ([markdown](./docs/components/task-list.md)): The agent's plan: steps with a status mark (chưa làm, đang làm, xong, lỗi, bỏ qua), an optional line under each, and a progress count. Components: TaskList.
- [Terminal](./components/terminal/) ([markdown](./docs/components/terminal.md)): A command and its output: streams and follows the end (unless people scroll up), shows a spinner while running and the exit code when done, with a copy button. Components: Terminal.
- [Tool call](./components/tool-call/) ([markdown](./docs/components/tool-call.md)): One tool the agent called: its name in words, a status badge (chờ, đang chạy, xong, lỗi, chờ duyệt), and on open the input and output (JSON formatted). Components: ToolCall.

### Blocks

- [Agent workspace](./components/agent-run/) ([markdown](./docs/components/agent-run.md)): A full agent turn composed from the AI parts: the request, reasoning, a plan, tool calls, an approval, the answer with sources and a composer with the context meter. Copy it with `semi add agent-run`. Components: .
- [Dashboard](./components/dashboard/) ([markdown](./docs/components/dashboard.md)): An overview page: title, KPI row with trends, a revenue chart, orders by status and the latest orders. Copy it with `semi add dashboard`, then replace the sample data. Components: .
- [List page](./components/list-page/) ([markdown](./docs/components/list-page.md)): A records page: title, toolbar (status pills, search, refresh, add), a data table that sorts, selects and pages, bulk actions. Copy it with `semi add list-page`. Components: .
- [Settings page](./components/settings-page/) ([markdown](./docs/components/settings-page.md)): A settings page: sections of rows with switches and links, a profile form with validation and one save action, and a danger zone. Copy it with `semi add settings-page`. Components: .

### Setup

- [Locale](./components/locale/) ([markdown](./docs/components/locale.md)): SemiLocaleProvider sets the UI strings of every Semi component (Vietnamese by default, English shipped, override any string). Components: SemiLocaleProvider.
- [Theme](./components/theme/) ([markdown](./docs/components/theme.md)): Light / dark / system: ThemeScript applies the stored theme before paint, ThemeProvider keeps it, ThemeSwitcher (three-way) and ThemeToggle switch it. data-theme on any element re-scopes every token inside it. Components: ThemeProvider, ThemeScript, ThemeSwitcher, ThemeToggle.

<!-- docs/QUICK_REF.md -->

# Semi Design System — Quick Reference

Component pages for agents: `docs/components/README.md` → `docs/components/<id>.md` (when to use, what instead, examples,
API from the types). Cheatsheet of `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`, which is the **single source of truth for UI rules** across the Semi ecosystem: a new
or changed rule goes into `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`, `docs/QUICK_REF.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md` (+ `lint/semi-lint.mjs` when
checkable) in the `semi-nextjs-codebase` repo, tagged with a new release. Never record UI rules in agent memory, skills
or per-project `AGENTS.md`.

Style: restrained dark & light dual-theme (`data-theme="dark|light"`) + bento cards, flat (no gradients, no glow), minimal text, collapsible neutral
left panel menu (`w-52` / `w-14`) floating on `bg-canvas` (`md:p-2 md:gap-2`), full-width right content panel (`md:rounded-panel bg-app`),
`font-display` page titles (`PageTitle` / `PageTabsTitle`, text only, no subtitle, no text buttons on the title row),
sticky sub-page toolbar row (`SubpageToolbar`: filters left, icon-only primary CTA + `SearchInput` + `RefreshButton` right).
Phones (`< md`) hide the top logo header and use `MobileTabBar` at the bottom (never a hamburger slide-over drawer).

**Two-Tier Semantic Tokens (Dark & Light Mode):**
| Semantic Token | Tailwind Class | Dark Mode (`[data-theme="dark"]`) | Light Mode (`[data-theme="light"]`) | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--color-canvas` | `bg-canvas` | `#0c0d0e` | `#f1f5f9` (Slate-100) | Outermost viewport frame |
| `--color-app` | `bg-app` | `#121316` | `#ffffff` | Main workspace & content canvas |
| `--color-panel` | `bg-panel` | `#18191c` | `#ffffff` | Bento Cards, Sidebar, Modals, Menus |
| `--color-field` | `bg-field` | `#1e1f23` | `#f1f5f9` (Slate-100) | Form inputs (`FIELD_INPUT`), table headers |
| `--color-raised` | `bg-raised` | `#26282e` | `#e2e8f0` (Slate-200) | Hover surface, subtle elevation, skeleton shimmer |
| `--color-text-contrast` | `text-contrast` | `#ffffff` | `#0f172a` (Slate-900) | Headings, active state, high-contrast text |
| `--color-text-body` | `text-body` | `#d1d5db` (Gray-300) | `#334155` (Slate-700) | Primary UI labels, body text |
| `--color-text-muted` | `text-muted` | `#8b919a` | `#5b6779` | Captions, placeholders, inactive hints |
| `--color-line` | `border-line` | `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` | `rgba(0,0,0,0.08)` (Slate-200) | Borders on cards, panels, inputs, dividers |
| `--color-line-hover` | `border-line-hover` | `rgba(255,255,255,0.16)` | `rgba(0,0,0,0.16)` (Slate-300) | Hover border state |
| `--color-divider` | `border-divider` | `rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` | `rgba(0,0,0,0.05)` (Slate-100) | Subtle row & item separators |

*Accent & status (AA in both themes):* solid action `bg-accent hover:bg-accent-hover text-on-accent` · primary text/icon `text-accent-fg` · status text `text-danger-fg` / `text-success-fg` / `text-warning-fg` / `text-info-fg` · tonal text `text-tone-<hue>`. Never `text-*-400` or `text-*-700 dark:text-*-300` in shared UI.

*Theme:* `<html suppressHydrationWarning>` + `<ThemeScript />` in `<head>` (no flash) + `<ThemeProvider defaultTheme="dark">` (same options); `<ThemeSwitcher />` (Sáng · Tối · Hệ thống, settings / sidebar footer) or `<ThemeToggle />` (one-tap dark/light), or `const { theme, resolvedTheme, mounted, setTheme } = useTheme()`. `data-theme="system"` follows the OS.

**Colour:** primary `#00AE42` (`primary-*`, overridable per project in `@theme`) = actions, focus, "on". `emerald-*` = status/success only.
amber = busy/warning · rose = error/danger. Nav menu: grey 16px icons, no count badges, active = `bg-white/[0.10] text-contrast`.
Chips (`Chip`, `chipClass(active)`): `rounded-full h-control px-3.5`, ghost when off, active uses semantic high-contrast background; colour only on a
leading dot or icon (`TONE_DOT`, `chipIconClass(tone)`). Card tiles keep their area tint. Flat: no gradients, no glow
blobs, no `shadow-[0_0_…]` (status dots and power buttons too). Active card = `CARD_ACTIVE` (primary border).

**Type:** page title (`PageTitle` / `PageTabsTitle`) `font-display text-heading sm:text-display font-semibold tracking-tight text-contrast` ·
KPI figure (`KpiCard`) `text-kpi sm:text-heading font-semibold tabular-nums text-contrast` · section `text-ui`–`text-title`
font-semibold text-contrast` · UI `text-label font-medium text-body` · label `text-label font-medium text-muted` ·
caption `text-caption`–`text-label` text-muted` · numbers `tabular-nums` (Geist; `font-mono` only for code) · Geist +
Montserrat Alternates (`font-display`) · weights medium/semibold · type scale only: `text-caption` 11 · `label` 12 · `ui` 13 · `ui-lg` 14 · `title` 15 · `title-lg` 16 · `kpi` 18 · `heading-sm` 20 · `heading` 22 · `heading-lg` 24 · `display` 26 (no `text-xs/sm`, no `text-[13px]`) ·
sentence case, no ALL CAPS.

**Status, layers, elevation:** callouts / badges `bg-{danger,success,warning,info}-bg border-*-border text-*-fg` (`Alert`) ·
dots / bars `bg-*-solid` · backdrop `bg-overlay` · floating layers `shadow-overlay` (canvas controls `shadow-float`) ·
layers `z-sticky` < `z-drawer` < `z-modal` < `z-dialog` < `z-keypad` < `z-popover` < `z-toast` < `z-tooltip` (no `z-[9999]`).

**A11y & strings:** icon-only controls need `aria-label` · forms use `Field` (label / hint / error wired) · dialogs are
`Modal` / `Drawer` / `confirmDialog` (focus trap, Escape, focus return) · keep `FOCUS_RING` on custom controls · UI text
in shared components comes from `useSemiLocale()` (`<SemiLocaleProvider locale={en}>`).

**Style (docs/STYLES.md):** the app's style sets the neutral colours behind `bg-*` / `text-*` / `border-line`, the fonts
(`font-sans`, `font-display`), control sizes `h-control` (toolbar buttons, pills, chips, search) / `h-field` (inputs,
selects), the card border (`border-card`, in `CARD`) and the shape below. Never `h-[34px]` or a per-style class.

**Shape (style tokens):** marks / checkboxes / inline code `rounded-chip` · controls / tiles / rows
`rounded-control` · cards / popovers / menus / toasts `rounded-card` · panels / hero / modal / sidebar `rounded-panel` ·
pills / avatars / dots `rounded-full` · resting card shadow `shadow-card` (in `CARD`; none in Flat). The app's style
(`<html data-style>`: Flat by default, Soft or Sharp) sets the values. Never `rounded`, `rounded-lg/xl/2xl` or `rounded-[Npx]`.

**Use the shared blocks (`@semi/ui` and `@semi/ui/styles`) — never create a local `ui.tsx` wrapper barrel:**
- **Layout & Structure (`@semi/ui`):**
  - `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`, `ThemeToggle`: Zero-runtime-overhead dual-theme management via `data-theme` attribute and CSS variables.
  - `AppShell` (+ `MobileTabBar`, `TAB_BAR_PAD`): 2-panel floating Bento frame on `bg-canvas`, collapsible `w-52`/`w-14` sidebar with grouped `sections`, and mobile bottom tab bar.
  - `PageTitle`, `PageTabsTitle`: text-only display heading or underline tab heading (`h-[2.5px] bg-primary`).
  - `SubpageToolbar`: sticky toolbar (`STICKY_TOOLBAR`) with `left` filters and `right` icon-only `BTN_PRIMARY BTN_ICON` + `SearchInput` + `RefreshButton`.
  - `KpiCard`: metric card with `18px–22px` `tabular-nums` value, coloured icon in label, and shimmer `loading` state.
  - `Modal`: portal dialog with `MODAL_BACKDROP`, `MODAL_PANEL`, `MODAL_HEAD`, `MODAL_CLOSE`, and `footer` (`MODAL_FOOT`).
- **Controls (`@semi/ui`):**
  - `Icon` (stroke 1.75, `w-4 h-4`), `IconTile` (`size="sm|md|lg"`). Follow semantic icon mapping in `docs/ICONS.md` (e.g. `trash` for delete, `close` for dialog dismiss, `refresh` for sync, `sliders` for parameters, `user` for profiles, `filter` for lists, `sun`/`moon` for theme). New icons go into `ICONS` in `@semi/ui` (never inline `<svg><path>`; no ✕ ✓ ✗ glyphs).
  - `Pills`, `Chip` (+ `tone`), `Badge` (`tone="purple|blue|emerald|amber|rose|sky|..."`), `SearchInput`, `CustomSelect` (toolbar default vs `variant="field"` in forms), `CustomCombobox`, `DatePicker`, `Pagination`, `NumberInput` (+ `NumPadPopup`). Never native `<select>`, `type="date"`, `type="number"`.
  - `AppHeader` (stand-alone tool/3D app top bar), `PageActions`, `SidePanel`, `RefreshButton`, `ExternalLink`, `Markdown`.
  - Loading: `Skeleton` / `SkeletonCard` / `SkeletonGrid` / `SkeletonRows` / `PageSkeleton`; no "Đang tải…" text or page spinners.
  - Confirmations: `confirmDialog({ title, message, confirmLabel, tone, icon })` + `<ConfirmHost />`, never `window.confirm`.
  - AI chat (§14b): `<AIChat messages busy onSend onStop onRetry onNewChat empty toolbar />` (or `ChatPanel` > `ChatView` > `ChatList` + `ChatComposer` with `UserMessage` / `AssistantMessage` / `ChatError` / `ChatThinking` / `ChatIntro` / `ChatSuggestion`). UI only: the app keeps messages and streaming; the provider → model → effort chips are `toolbar={<ChatModelPicker providers models efforts … />}`. Never a local composer or bubbles.
- **Style Constants (`@semi/ui/styles`):**
  - `surfaces.ts`: `SHELL_OUTER`, `SHELL_ASIDE`, `SHELL_MAIN`, `SHELL_CONTAINER`, `CARD`, `CARD_HOVER`, `CARD_ACTIVE`, `HERO`, `TILE`, `SECTION_*`, `COUNT_PILL`, `EMPTY`, `ICON_BTN*`, `STATUS_PILL`, `STATUS_DOT`, `TONAL_SURFACE`, `TONAL_CONTAINER`, `TONAL_HOVER`, `BADGE_BASE`, `STICKY_TOOLBAR`, `MODAL_*`, `FIELD_LABEL`, `FIELD_INPUT`, `FIELD_TEXTAREA`.
  - `buttons.ts`: `BTN_PRIMARY`, `BTN_SECONDARY`, `BTN_DANGER`, `BTN_ICON`, `MODAL_BTN_*`.
  - `appChrome.ts`: `HEADER_ICON_*`, `headerPrimary`, `HEADER_PILL`, `VIEWPORT_*`.

## Anti-patterns & Token Rules (enforced by `npx semi-lint`)
- **No literal palette colors (`no-literal-palette`):** Never use direct physical classes like `bg-white`, `text-slate-900`, `border-slate-200`, `divide-slate-100`, `bg-slate-50`, `bg-gray-800/900`. Always use Semantic Tokens (`bg-panel`, `bg-field`, `text-contrast`, `text-body`, `text-muted`, `border-line`, `divide-divider`).
- **No fixed chromatic text (`no-fixed-tone-text`):** `text-emerald-400`, `text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300`, `fill-sky-500` → `text-accent-fg`, `text-*-fg`, `text-tone-<hue>`.
- **No arbitrary colours / sizes:** `bg-[#…]`, `text-[rgb(…)]` (`hex-colour-class`), `"#fff"` in style props or configs (`literal-colour-value`), `text-[13px]` (`arbitrary-text-size`).
- **No solid pastel surfaces (`no-solid-pastel-surfaces`):** Never use solid pastels (`bg-*-50`, `border-*-200`) for cards, rows, or containers; in dark mode they turn into glaring light rectangles. Use alpha transparency (`bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/20`) or standard `bg-panel`.
- **Universal Tonal Theme-Matching:** Chromatic accents across ANY component (cards, alert banners, callouts, table rows, buttons, badges, chips) adapt seamlessly to both dark & light themes using alpha transparency: static fill `bg-<color>-500/10`, hover fill `hover:bg-<color>-500/15`, active fill `active:bg-<color>-500/20`, border `border-<color>-500/20`, hover border `hover:border-<color>-500/30`, and text `text-tone-<color>` (or `TONAL_CONTAINER` / `TONAL_HOVER` / `<Badge tone="...">`).
- **No Card class override (`card-class-override`):** `<Card>` (`interactive`, `active`) owns its surface: no `bg-*` / `shadow-*` in its className.
- **Surfaces & Shadows:** Gradients, glow, `shadow-[0_0_…]`, `shadow-sm/md/lg` are banned. Cards are separated by borders (`border-line`); their only resting shadow is `shadow-card`, which the style sets (none in Flat, soft in Soft, hard offset in Sharp).
- **Typography:** `font-bold`, `text-[9|10px]`, `text-xs/sm`, uppercase labels, ALL CAPS buttons.
- **Radii (`radius-token`):** `rounded`, `rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl`, `rounded-[Npx]` (they ignore the app's style); per-style classes or `[data-style=…]` selectors in an app.
- **Navigation & Layout:** fixed `border-r` sidebars or `-translate-x-full` hamburger drawers (use `AppShell` + `MobileTabBar`) · local `ui.tsx` wrapper barrels (`PageHeader`, `Select`, `Input`, `Button`, `Modal`): use `Button`, `Field` + `Input`, `CustomSelect`, `Modal`, `EmptyState` from `@semi/ui`.
- **Icons & Controls:** emoji / ✕ ✓ glyphs, stroke 2+, inline `<path>` · native `<select>` / date / number inputs, `window.confirm` · "Đang tải…" text · Home button in app headers, page subtitles, text buttons on the page title row.
