## 4. Bổ sung Icon mới vào Design System (Dành cho Maintainer)

Nếu một dự án mới thực sự cần một icon mới chưa có trong danh mục:
1. **Không tạo icon cục bộ trong project con.**
2. Mở repo `@semi/ui` (`semi-nextjs-codebase`).
3. Lấy path SVG chuẩn Lucide (kích thước viewBox `0 0 24 24`).
4. Thêm key vào `ICONS` trong [`src/Icon.tsx`](file:///Users/claw/Development/semi/core/nextjs-codebase/src/Icon.tsx).
5. Đăng ký metadata vào `ICON_CATALOG` trong [`src/iconCatalog.ts`](file:///Users/claw/Development/semi/core/nextjs-codebase/src/iconCatalog.ts) và cập nhật file [`docs/ICONS.md`](file:///Users/claw/Development/semi/core/nextjs-codebase/docs/ICONS.md) này.
6. Chạy `npm run check`, nâng version và tạo tag release mới. Mọi app khác chỉ cần chạy `/semi-update` là nhận được icon mới.


---

<!-- docs/BRANDS.md -->

# Thương hiệu trên Semi (brand kit)

Semi là bộ kit gốc để làm phần mềm cho nhiều thương hiệu (công ty con, khách hàng). Mỗi thương hiệu có **một brand kit
riêng** sinh ra từ Semi; mọi sản phẩm của thương hiệu đó dùng brand kit, nên luôn cùng màu, cùng font, cùng luật.

```
Semi core (@semi/ui)              cố định cho mọi thương hiệu
  component, luật, lint, template style (Flat / Soft / Sharp), bộ sinh màu
        │  /semi-brand
        ▼
Brand kit (vd. @3dnoobs/brand)    lựa chọn của một thương hiệu, repo GitHub riêng
  brand.json (bạn chọn) → dist/brand.css, dist/brand.json, BRAND.md, AGENTS.brand.md
        │  /semi-init --brand  ·  /semi-update
        ▼
Sản phẩm (Manager, Store, …)       chỉ dùng: không tự chọn màu / font, không ghi đè token
```

- **Bạn chỉ quyết định vài thứ**, một lần, trong repo brand: màu chính, màu phụ (tuỳ chọn), màu trung tính, các style
  được dùng, font. Phần còn lại (thang màu, màu cho nền tối / sáng, chữ trên nút, đảm bảo đọc rõ) do Semi tự sinh.
- **Mọi màu đều đạt chuẩn đọc rõ (WCAG AA)** ở cả theme sáng và tối: bộ sinh tự chỉnh, và báo lỗi nếu một màu không
  thể dùng được.
- **Sản phẩm không thể đi lệch:** `semi-lint` chặn việc ghi đè màu thương hiệu trong sản phẩm (`brand-override`),
  `/semi-audit` kiểm tra sản phẩm đang dùng đúng brand kit, đúng style được phép.

---

## Ví dụ từ đầu: thương hiệu 3D Noobs và app Manager

### Phần A — Tạo thương hiệu (làm một lần)

**Bước 1. Tạo repo trống cho brand kit**

```bash
mkdir -p ~/Development/3dnoobs-brand
```

Mở thư mục đó bằng Claude Code (hoặc agent có plugin `semi-design`).
👉 *Bạn làm:* tạo thư mục, mở nó. Không cần cài gì.

**Bước 2. Gõ `/semi-brand` và trả lời vài câu**

| Agent hỏi | Ví dụ trả lời | Ghi chú |
|---|---|---|
| Tên thương hiệu, tên package | 3D Noobs · `@3dnoobs/brand` | Package là tên sản phẩm sẽ cài |
| Màu chính | `#00AE42` | Mã hex, hoặc gửi logo để agent đọc màu |
| Màu phụ | (bỏ qua) | Tuỳ chọn; agent gợi ý theo hoà sắc |
| Màu trung tính | Phủ theo màu chính | Hoặc giữ màu trung tính có sẵn của từng style |
| Style mặc định, style được phép | Flat · Flat + Soft | Mỗi sản phẩm chọn trong danh sách này |
| Font | Geist + Montserrat Alternates | Chọn trong danh sách, hoặc tên một Google Font |

👉 *Bạn làm:* chọn. *Agent làm:* tạo repo kit (`package.json`, `brand.json`, workflow GitHub Pages), cài `@semi/ui`
và Next.js (cho trang preview), sinh `dist/`.

**Bước 3. Xem trước ngay trong repo brand và chỉnh**

Agent chạy trang preview **của chính repo brand** (`npm run preview`) và gửi link local:
**http://localhost:4600**. Trang dựng bằng `@semi/ui` thật cùng `brand.css` của kit: màu, chữ, nút & form, thẻ, bảng,
thông báo… trong màu 3D Noobs, đổi sáng / tối ở chân menu và giữa các style được phép, kèm bảng điểm đọc rõ. Trang
gồm phần tổng quan thương hiệu và **toàn bộ component của Semi** (cùng các trang như docs của Semi: ví dụ, code, API).

👉 *Bạn làm:* mở link, nhìn và nói điều muốn đổi ("màu chính đậm hơn", "dùng màu trung tính có sẵn"). *Agent làm:* sửa
`brand.json`, sinh lại; trang đang mở tự cập nhật.

Repo kit sau bước này:

```
brand.json          lựa chọn của bạn (file duy nhất người sửa)
dist/brand.css      sinh ra: màu, font, màu trung tính cho từng style (đã kiểm tra đọc rõ)
dist/brand.json     sinh ra: toàn bộ giá trị + font để sản phẩm nạp
BRAND.md            sinh ra: guideline thương hiệu, người đọc được
AGENTS.brand.md     sinh ra: luật cho agent ở mọi sản phẩm của thương hiệu
package.json        "@3dnoobs/brand", phụ thuộc "@semi/ui" (+ Next.js cho trang preview)
.github/workflows/brand-pages.yml   build trang preview và đăng lên GitHub Pages mỗi lần push
.preview/           trang preview sinh ra khi chạy (không commit)
```

**Bước 4. Chốt, phát hành và xem online**

👉 *Bạn làm:* nói "ok, publish" và tạo repo GitHub cho kit (vd. `3dnoobs/brand`) nếu chưa có.
*Agent làm:* `npm run check`, commit, push, gắn tag `v1.0.0`, bật GitHub Pages cho repo (`brand.mjs pages`, nguồn:
GitHub Actions). Workflow `brand-pages.yml` build trang preview và đăng lên **https://&lt;owner&gt;.github.io/&lt;repo&gt;/**;
mỗi lần push lên main nó build lại. Từ đây 3D Noobs có bộ nhận diện riêng, ai cũng xem được online.

> Repo private: GitHub Pages cho repo private cần gói GitHub có hỗ trợ (Pro / Team / Enterprise). Không có thì để repo
> brand public (nó chỉ chứa màu, font, guideline), hoặc chỉ xem local.

### Phần B — Tạo app Manager

**Bước 5. Tạo thư mục trống và gõ**

```text
/semi-init --brand github:3dnoobs/brand
```

Agent chỉ hỏi tên app ("3D Noobs Manager") và style (trong danh sách brand cho phép: app quản lý chọn Flat). Không hỏi
màu, font: đã có trong brand.
👉 *Bạn làm:* trả lời 2 câu.

**Bước 6. Agent dựng app**

Next.js + `@semi/ui` + `@3dnoobs/brand`, rồi nối sẵn:

```css
/* app/globals.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
/* semi-design-system:start */
@import "@semi/ui/tokens.css";
@import "@semi/ui/base.css";
@import "@3dnoobs/brand/dist/brand.css";
/* semi-design-system:end */
```

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx: font của brand + style đã chọn
<html data-style="flat" className={`dark ${geist.variable} ${montserratAlternates.variable}`}>
```

Cùng với `semi-lint.json` (`"brand": "@3dnoobs/brand"`, `"style": "flat"`), luật của brand trong `AGENTS.md`, trang mẫu
(AppShell, KpiCard…), rồi kiểm tra `semi-lint` + `tsc` + build.
👉 *Bạn làm:* không gì cả, đợi báo xong.

**Bước 7. Phát triển như bình thường**

Bạn nói "làm trang quản lý đơn hàng"; agent dùng component Semi, màu 3D Noobs tự áp. Nếu ai đó viết `--color-primary-500`
hay `--semi-…` trong CSS của app, `semi-lint` chặn (`brand-override`): màu chỉ đến từ brand.

### Phần C — Về sau

| Chuyện | Bạn làm | Ở đâu |
|---|---|---|
| Làm thêm app **Store** | `/semi-init --brand github:3dnoobs/brand`, chọn Soft | Thư mục mới |
| 3D Noobs **đổi màu chính** | `/semi-brand` → "đổi primary sang `#00C853`" → xem trước → tag mới | Repo brand |
| … rồi đưa vào các app | `/semi-update` (đổi màu thấy rõ: agent hỏi trước) | Từng app |
| **Semi** ra bản mới | `/semi-brand update` (sinh lại kit) | Repo brand |
| … rồi đưa vào các app | `/semi-update` | Từng app |
| App đổi sang style khác **đã được cho phép** | `/semi-style` | Repo app |
| Style **chưa được cho phép** | `/semi-brand` (thêm vào danh sách) → `/semi-update` → `/semi-style` | Repo brand → app |
| Kiểm tra định kỳ | `/semi-audit` → `/semi-fix` | Từng app |

---

## Khi nào dùng lệnh nào

| | `/semi-brand` · `/semi-brand update` | `/semi-update` |
|---|---|---|
| Chạy ở | Repo **brand kit** | Repo **sản phẩm** |
| Làm gì | Tạo / sửa lựa chọn thương hiệu (`/semi-brand`); sinh lại kit cho bản Semi mới, không đổi lựa chọn (`/semi-brand update`) | Đưa sản phẩm lên `@semi/ui` và brand kit mới nhất tương thích, chạy migration, `tsc` |
| Đổi lựa chọn thương hiệu | `/semi-brand`: có · `update`: không | Không bao giờ |
| Sửa code sản phẩm | Không | Có (migration) |
| Kết quả | Kit có tag mới | Sản phẩm dùng bản mới |

Luôn đi **từ trên xuống**: Semi → brand kit → sản phẩm.

**Phiên bản brand kit:**

| Mức | Khi nào | `/semi-update` ở sản phẩm |
|---|---|---|
| patch | Sinh lại, giao diện không đổi | Tự cập nhật |
| minor | Thêm lựa chọn (style được phép, màu phụ, token mới) | Tự cập nhật |
| major | Màu / font thương hiệu đổi, thấy rõ | Hỏi trước (`--accept-major`) |

Brand kit ghi nó chạy với `@semi/ui` nào (`"semi": "^0.6"` trong `brand.json`). Nếu Semi mới nhất nằm ngoài dải đó,
`/semi-update` giữ Semi ở bản tương thích mới nhất và nhắc chạy `/semi-brand update` trong repo brand.

---

## `brand.json`

```json
{
  "name": "3D Noobs",
  "package": "@3dnoobs/brand",
  "primary": "#00AE42",
  "secondary": null,
  "neutral": "tinted",
  "styles": { "default": "flat", "allowed": ["flat", "soft"] },
  "fonts": { "sans": "Geist", "display": "Montserrat Alternates" },
  "semi": "^0.6"
}
```

| Khoá | Giá trị | Quy chuẩn |
|---|---|---|
| `name`, `package` | Tên hiển thị, tên npm (`@scope/brand`) | Bắt buộc |
| `primary` | Hex | Bắt buộc. Không quá xám (độ đậm tối thiểu), bộ sinh tự chọn sắc độ đọc rõ |
| `secondary` | Hex hoặc `null` | Tuỳ chọn; sinh `secondary-50 … 900` (`bg-secondary-500`, `text-secondary-fg`) |
| `neutral` | `"tinted"` / `"preset"` | `tinted`: màu trung tính của mỗi style phủ nhẹ tông màu chính (bề mặt gần như trung tính, chữ và viền có tông rõ hơn). `preset`: giữ màu trung tính có sẵn của style |
| `styles.default`, `styles.allowed` | `flat` · `soft` · `sharp` | Ít nhất một; `default` phải nằm trong `allowed` |
| `fonts.sans`, `fonts.display` | Tên Google Font | `next/font/google` phải có font đó |
| `semi` | Dải phiên bản `@semi/ui` | `/semi-brand update` cập nhật |

Chi tiết kỹ thuật: bộ sinh màu nằm ở `@semi/ui/brand` (`generateBrand`), lệnh trong kit là `semi-brand build | check`
(bin của `@semi/ui`). Style có sẵn: [STYLES.md](STYLES.md).


---

<!-- docs/STYLES.md -->

# Semi styles

A **style** is the look of the whole UI: neutral colours, fonts, radii, card border and shadow, control sizes. An app
picks one style, once (Flat, Soft or Sharp); every `@semi/ui` component and class constant follows it. Shared by all
styles: components and their API, layout (AppShell, PageTitle, SubpageToolbar …), the type scale, the accent (brand,
per app: §2b), status and tone colours, both themes (light / dark), icons, accessibility and lint rules.

| | Flat (default) | Soft | Sharp |
|---|---|---|---|
| For | Dense, information-first screens: dashboards, tools, admin | Calm, friendly screens: consumer apps, storefronts, onboarding | Bold, editorial screens: landing pages, portfolios, creative tools |
| Fonts | Geist + Montserrat Alternates (titles) | Plus Jakarta Sans | Space Grotesk |
| Card (`border-card`, `shadow-card`) | 1px line border, no shadow | No visible border, soft lifted shadow | 2px solid border, hard 4px offset shadow |
| Lines (`border-line`) | 8–9% | 9%, tinted | 18–32%, strong |
| `rounded-chip` / `control` / `card` / `panel` | 4 · 8 · 12 · 16px | 6 · 12 · 20 · 24px | 2 · 0 · 0 · 0 |
| `h-control` / `h-field` | 34 / 36px | 40 / 44px | 36 / 40px |

Every style passes WCAG AA on every Storybook page in both themes (Playwright, `npm run test:ui`).

Each style sets its own neutral colours (`semantic` in `tokens/styles/<id>.json`, both themes): Flat uses the shared
neutrals of `tokens/tokens.json`, Soft a warm sand, Sharp off-black and off-white. The accent stays the product's brand
and the status colours keep their meaning.

Source: `tokens/styles/<id>.json` (`tokens`: shape, card border, fonts, sizes; `semantic`: neutral colours per theme;
`fonts`: what the app loads) → `npm run build:tokens` → `[data-style="<id>"]` blocks in `tokens.css` and the list in
`tokens/styles.json` (`@semi/ui/styles.json`). Preview: the Flat / Sharp / Soft switch at the bottom of the Storybook
sidebar.

A brand kit (docs/BRANDS.md) builds on these: it picks the allowed styles and either tints their neutrals with its
primary or keeps the style's own neutrals (`"neutral": "preset"`), so products of a brand never set neutral colours.

## Picking a style in an app

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx: data-style on <html> (off = Flat)
<html lang="vi" data-style="soft" suppressHydrationWarning>
```

plus the style's fonts with `next/font` (the `fonts` list in `@semi/ui/styles.json`; Soft: `Plus_Jakarta_Sans` with
`variable: "--font-jakarta"` on `<html className>`), and the same id in `semi-lint.json` (`"style": "soft"`).
`/semi-audit` checks all three against each other. `/semi-init`
asks for the style of a new app, `/semi-fix` foundation for an existing one, `/semi-style` switches it later. A wrapper
with `data-style` re-styles only its subtree (used by Storybook previews), not something an app needs.

## Rules

- Use the style tokens only: `rounded-chip` (marks, checkboxes, inline code) · `rounded-control` (buttons, inputs,
  selects, tiles, list rows) · `rounded-card` (cards, popovers, menus, toasts) · `rounded-panel` (hero, modal, drawer,
  sheet, sidebar) · `rounded-full` / `rounded-none` (the same in every style) · `shadow-card` (resting cards, in `CARD`).
  `semi-lint` (`radius-token`) flags `rounded`, `rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl` and `rounded-[Npx]`; the `/semi-fix` token
  codemod maps them (`lg` → `control`, `xl` → `card`, `2xl` → `panel`, `sm` / `md` / bare → `chip`; `shadow-sm` → `shadow-card`).
- An app never writes per-style CSS or `[data-style=…]` selectors: when one screen needs another shape, the style is
  missing a token, so propose it upstream (`/semi-propose`).
- Sizes: toolbar controls `h-control` / `w-control`, form inputs and selects `h-field`; never `h-[34px]` (the codemod maps it).
- Colours: the semantic tokens only (`bg-panel`, `text-muted`, `border-line` …): their values change per style. The
  accent is the product's brand, not the style's.
- Fonts: `font-sans` / `font-display` only. An app with its own brand fonts sets `--font-sans-family` /
  `--font-display-family`, which every style then uses.
- Floating layers keep `shadow-overlay` / `shadow-float` in every style.

## Adding a style (maintainers)

1. Copy `tokens/styles/flat.json` to `tokens/styles/<id>.json`; set `name`, `description`, `fonts` (Google fonts
   `next/font` can load, with their CSS variable), every token (the build fails when a key is missing or extra) and,
   when it has its own neutrals, `semantic` (dark + light). Exactly one file has `"default": true`. Load its fonts in
   `app/layout.tsx` of the Storybook.
2. `npm run build:tokens`, then add its column above. `check:manifest` fails while a style has no column here.
3. `npm run build:storybook && npm run test:ui`: contrast and phone layout run for every style in both themes.
4. CHANGELOG (a new style is a minor release). Changing a value of an existing style changes every app on it: note it
   under "Changed". Renaming or removing a style needs a release migration (`migrations/`) that rewrites
   `semi-lint.json` and the `<html data-style>` of apps that used it.


---

<!-- plugin/rules/AGENTS.md -->

<!-- semi-design-system:start -->
# Semi Design System — UI Rules

All web UI in the Semi ecosystem MUST follow the **Semi Design System** (`@semi/ui`, repo `https://github.com/hoanghuynh296/semi-nextjs-codebase`).

1. **Single source of truth, ask it first:** before writing UI, find the component for the need: the `semi` MCP tools (`semi_search` → `semi_docs` → `semi_example`, `semi_block` for whole pages) or the same from the terminal (`npx semi search "bảng có sắp xếp"`, `npx semi docs DataTable`, `npx semi example data-table`, `npx semi add dashboard`). They answer from the installed `@semi/ui`. Read the component's page (when to use, what to use instead, API, accessibility) and start from one of its examples; rules: `node_modules/@semi/ui/docs/QUICK_REF.md` (details in `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`). Do not invent local colour classes, font sizes, radii, or custom wrapper barrels (`components/ui.tsx`).
2. **Use `@semi/ui` and `@semi/ui/styles` directly:**
   - **Layout & Page Structure (`@semi/ui`):** `AppShell` (floating 2-panel Bento frame on `bg-canvas` with collapsible `w-52`/`w-14` sidebar and `MobileTabBar` on phones — never use a fixed `border-r` or `-translate-x-full` hamburger `<aside>`), `PageTitle` / `PageTabsTitle` (text-only display title or underline group tabs — never place text buttons on the title row), `SubpageToolbar` (`STICKY_TOOLBAR` with filters left and icon-only `BTN_PRIMARY BTN_ICON` + `SearchInput` + `RefreshButton` right), `KpiCard` (`18px–22px` tabular-nums metric card), `Modal` (shared portal dialog with `MODAL_HEAD` + `MODAL_FOOT`), `ThemeScript` (in `<head>`, with `<html suppressHydrationWarning>`) + `ThemeProvider` / `ThemeSwitcher` / `ThemeToggle` (dual-theme Dark/Light/System via `data-theme`), `Card` (`interactive`, `active`; no `bg-*`/`shadow-*` overrides).
   - **Primitives (`@semi/ui`):** `Button` (`variant`, `size`, `icon`, `iconOnly` + `aria-label`, `loading`), `Field` + `Input` / `Textarea` (label, hint, error wired for screen readers), `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `RadioGroup`, `Tabs`, `Tooltip`, `Menu` (overflow actions), `toast()` + `ToastHost`, `Alert`, `Progress`, `Avatar`, `EmptyState`, `Table` (`THead`/`TBody`/`TR`/`TH`/`TD`), `Drawer`, `Spinner`, `SemiLocaleProvider` (UI strings, `vi` default / `en`). Inventory with props: `node_modules/@semi/ui/components.json`.
   - **Controls (`@semi/ui`):** `Icon`, `IconTile`, `AppHeader`, `PageActions`, `Chip`, `Pills`, `CustomSelect`, `CustomCombobox`, `NumberInput`, `DatePicker`, `SearchInput`, `Pagination`, `SidePanel`, `RefreshButton`, `Skeleton` (`SkeletonCard`, `SkeletonGrid`, `SkeletonRows`, `PageSkeleton`), `confirmDialog` + `ConfirmHost`, `ExternalLink`, `Markdown`.
   - **AI chat (`@semi/ui`):** `AIChat` (or `ChatPanel` > `ChatView` > `ChatList` + `ChatComposer` with `UserMessage`, `AssistantMessage`, `ChatError`, `ChatThinking`, `ChatIntro`, `ChatSuggestion`) for every AI conversation, with `ChatModelPicker` (provider → model → effort) as its `toolbar`; the app keeps messages, streaming and the provider / model lists. Never build its own composer, bubbles or chat panel. Agent work shows with `Reasoning`, `ToolCall`, `TaskList`, `Terminal`, `FileTree`, `Sources` + `Citation`, `ContextMeter`; every outward-facing, paid or irreversible agent action waits for `ActionConfirmation`.
   - **Styles (`@semi/ui/styles`):** `SHELL_*`, `CARD`, `CARD_HOVER`, `CARD_ACTIVE`, `HERO`, `TILE`, `SECTION_*`, `STICKY_TOOLBAR`, `MODAL_*`, `FIELD_LABEL`, `FIELD_INPUT`, `FIELD_TEXTAREA`, `STATUS_DOT`, `STATUS_PILL`, `BTN_PRIMARY`, `BTN_SECONDARY`, `BTN_DANGER`, `BTN_GHOST`, `BTN_SM`, `BTN_ICON`, `MODAL_BTN_*`, `headerPrimary`, `VIEWPORT_*`, `TONAL_SURFACE`, `EMPTY_STATIC`, `cn()`, `FOCUS_RING`, `OVERLAY`.
3. **Hard constraints (enforced by `npx semi-lint`):**
   - Flat surfaces & semantic tokens only (`bg-canvas`, `bg-app`, `bg-panel`, `bg-field`, `bg-raised`, `text-contrast`, `text-body`, `text-muted`, `border-line`, `border-divider`). Status surfaces: `bg-danger-bg border-danger-border text-danger-fg` (also success / warning / info, `bg-*-solid` for dots and bars). Backdrops `bg-overlay`; floating layers `shadow-overlay` (canvas controls `shadow-float`); global layers `z-sticky` < `z-drawer` < `z-modal` < `z-dialog` < `z-keypad` < `z-popover` < `z-toast` < `z-tooltip` (never `z-[9999]`). No gradients, no glow shadows (`shadow-[0_0_…]`), no drop shadows on surfaces other than `shadow-card`, no arbitrary colours (`bg-[#...]`, `text-[rgb(…)]`) and no literal colours in code (`"#fff"`).
   - Never use physical Tailwind color classes (`bg-white`, `text-slate-900`, `border-slate-200`, `bg-slate-50`, `bg-gray-800/900`) directly in JSX (`no-literal-palette`). Use Semantic Tokens so interfaces adapt automatically to Dark and Light modes. Coloured text uses themed tokens, never fixed `-300/-400` shades or `dark:` pairs: `text-accent-fg` (primary text/icons), `text-danger-fg` / `text-success-fg` / `text-warning-fg` / `text-info-fg`, `text-tone-<hue>`; solid actions `bg-accent hover:bg-accent-hover text-on-accent` (or `BTN_PRIMARY`). Never pass background or shadow overrides to `<Card>` (`card-class-override`).
   - Never use solid pastel surface classes (`bg-*-50`, `border-*-200`) for cards or containers (`no-solid-pastel-surfaces`); use alpha transparency (`bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/20`) or standard `bg-panel`.
   - Typography: `font-medium` / `font-semibold` only (no `font-bold`); the type scale only: `text-caption` 11 · `text-label` 12 · `text-ui` 13 · `text-ui-lg` 14 · `text-title` 15 · `text-title-lg` 16 for UI/body, `text-kpi sm:text-heading` for KPI figures (`KpiCard`), `text-heading sm:text-display` for page titles (`PageTitle`); no `text-xs/sm/base` and no `text-[13px]`; `tabular-nums` for numbers (`font-mono` only for code); sentence case (no `uppercase` labels or ALL CAPS buttons).
   - Style: the app's style (Flat, Soft, Sharp): `"style"` in `semi-lint.json`, `data-style` on `<html>`, its fonts loaded with `next/font`; `node_modules/@semi/ui/docs/STYLES.md`) sets the neutral colours, fonts (`font-sans`, `font-display`), control sizes (`h-control` for toolbar buttons / pills / chips / search, `h-field` for inputs and selects, never `h-[34px]`), the card border (`border-card`) and every radius and card shadow, so use the style tokens only: `rounded-chip` (marks, checkboxes, inline code), `rounded-control` (buttons, inputs, tiles, rows), `rounded-card` (cards, popovers, menus, toasts), `rounded-panel` (hero, modal, drawer, sidebar), `rounded-full` (pills, avatars, dots), `shadow-card` (resting card shadow, `CARD` has it). Never `rounded`, `rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl` or `rounded-[Npx]` (`radius-token`), never per-style classes or `[data-style=…]` selectors in the app. Change the style with `/semi-style`.
   - Controls: never native `<select>`, `type="date"`, `type="number"`, or `window.confirm`/`alert`. Never inline `<svg><path>` or unicode glyph icons (✕ ✓ ✗ ⚠) — use `<Icon name="…" />` (stroke 1.75). Always follow semantic icon mappings (`node_modules/@semi/ui/docs/ICONS.md`): `trash` for delete/remove (never `close`), `close` for dialog dismiss (never `trash`), `refresh` for reload/sync, `sliders` for parameters/tuning, `filter` for search filters, `user`/`users` for profiles/teams, `settings` for app configuration, `sun`/`moon` for theme toggling.
   - Loading: use `Skeleton` shapes, never `"Đang tải…"` text or full-page spinners (`Button loading` / `Spinner` only inside the control that runs the action).
   - Accessibility: every icon-only control has an `aria-label`; dialogs are `Modal` / `Drawer` / `confirmDialog` (focus trap, Escape, focus return built in); custom controls keep the visible focus ring (`FOCUS_RING`); UI strings come from `SemiLocaleProvider`, not hard-coded inside shared components.
4. **Brand kits:** when `semi-lint.json` has `"brand"`, the product belongs to that brand (`node_modules/<brand>/BRAND.md`, rules block in `AGENTS.md`): never define colours, fonts or Semi tokens in the app (`brand-override`), only the brand's allowed styles. Never invent a brand colour: it comes from the user or the brand kit. Brand changes happen in the brand repo (`/semi-brand`), then `/semi-update` in the product (`node_modules/@semi/ui/docs/BRANDS.md`).
5. **Gaps go upstream, not into local primitives:** If `@semi/ui` cannot express a need (missing component, prop, token, icon, or a lint false positive), first run `/semi-update` and re-check the docs; if the gap remains, run `/semi-propose` to file it on the core repo. Meanwhile keep a minimal compliant local workaround marked `// TODO(semi#<issue>)` and baseline (never broadly `skip`) any lint hits.
6. **Never fork rules per project:** When the user changes a shared UI rule, update `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`, `docs/QUICK_REF.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, and `lint/semi-lint.mjs` in the `semi-nextjs-codebase` repository and release a new tag — never record shared UI rules only in a consumer project's `AGENTS.md` or agent memory. App-specific patterns belong in the app's own `docs/UI_EXTENSIONS.md`.
7. **Verification:** Run `npx semi-lint` (or `npm run semi:lint`) before finishing any UI change. For a whole-app check run `/semi-audit` (writes `semi-audit.md`), then `/semi-fix` to fix what it found; `/semi-update` moves to a newer `@semi/ui` and runs that release's migrations (no audit); `/semi-style` switches the style; `/semi-brand` creates or changes a brand kit (in its own repo).
<!-- semi-design-system:end -->


---

<!-- docs/components/button.md -->

# Button

The action control: one primary per area, secondary for the rest, danger for destructive actions, ghost for quiet ones. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it.

## When to use

- Any action: save, create, refresh, delete, open a dialog.
- Icon-only toolbar actions (iconOnly + aria-label).
- Dialog footers (size="modal": 44px touch target on phones).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Go to another page | next/link (styled with BTN_* from @semi/ui/styles when it must look like a button) |
| Link to another site | ExternalLink |
| Pick one of 2–5 filters | Pills |
| Turn a setting on / off | Switch |

## Import

```tsx
import { Button, Spinner } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Variants

primary for the main action of an area, secondary (default) for the rest, danger for destructive, ghost for quiet actions.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonVariants() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Button variant="primary">Lưu</Button>
      <Button>Huỷ</Button>
      <Button variant="danger">Xoá</Button>
      <Button variant="ghost">Xem thêm</Button>
      <Button disabled>Không khả dụng</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Icon and icon-only

icon adds a leading icon; iconOnly needs an aria-label.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonIcons() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Button variant="primary" icon="plus">
        Thêm máy in
      </Button>
      <Button icon="refresh">Làm mới</Button>
      <Button variant="danger" icon="trash">
        Xoá
      </Button>
      <Button variant="primary" iconOnly icon="plus" aria-label="Thêm mới" title="Thêm mới" />
      <Button iconOnly icon="download" aria-label="Tải xuống" title="Tải xuống" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Loading

loading swaps the icon for a spinner and blocks clicks.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Spinner } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonLoading() {
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const save = () => {
    setSaving(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaving(false), 1200);
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      <Button variant="primary" icon="check" loading={saving} onClick={save}>
        {saving ? "Đang lưu" : "Lưu"}
      </Button>
      <Spinner label="Đang đồng bộ" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Sizes

sm for dense rows, md (default) for toolbars and forms, modal for dialog footers.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonSizes() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button size="sm" icon="edit">
          Sửa (sm)
        </Button>
        <Button icon="edit">Sửa (md)</Button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2 max-w-sm">
        <Button size="modal" className="flex-1">
          Huỷ
        </Button>
        <Button size="modal" variant="primary" className="flex-1">
          Xác nhận
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Button

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` |  |  |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'danger' \| 'ghost'` | `"secondary"` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'modal'` | `"md"` | md = h-control toolbar / form (34px in Flat) · sm = 28px dense rows · modal = 44px on phones, 34px from sm (dialog footers). |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Leading icon from the Semi registry. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner in place of the icon and blocks clicks (aria-busy). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode \| undefined` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Defines a string value that labels the current element. |

### Spinner

Indeterminate activity mark for a button or field running its own action (§13b: no page spinners).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | `"w-4 h-4"` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Renders a real <button type="button"> (pass type="submit" in forms).
- iconOnly requires aria-label (the types enforce it); keep a title for the tooltip.
- loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks; the visible focus ring stays.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/button/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/button-group.md -->

# Button group

Joins related buttons into one segmented control: shared borders, outer corners only (‹ Hôm nay ›, Lưu | ▾).

## When to use

- Previous / today / next; a primary action with its overflow menu; zoom − / +.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Choose one value | ToggleGroup or Pills |

## Import

```tsx
import { ButtonGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Navigation and split button

```tsx
import { Button, ButtonGroup, Menu } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonGroupBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      <ButtonGroup label="Điều hướng ngày">
        <Button iconOnly icon="back" aria-label="Ngày trước" />
        <Button>Hôm nay</Button>
        <Button iconOnly icon="chevron" aria-label="Ngày sau" />
      </ButtonGroup>
      <ButtonGroup label="Lưu">
        <Button variant="primary" icon="check">
          Lưu
        </Button>
        <Menu
          label="Tuỳ chọn lưu"
          items={[
            { label: "Lưu bản nháp", icon: "fileText", onSelect: () => undefined },
            { label: "Lưu và in", icon: "printer", onSelect: () => undefined },
          ]}
        />
      </ButtonGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ButtonGroup

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group ("Điều hướng ngày"). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `"horizontal"` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Button elements (Button, or anything styled with BTN_*). |

## Accessibility

- role="group" with a label; each button keeps its own name.

<!-- docs/components/chip.md -->

# Chip

A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags. Neutral when off; active uses the high-contrast surface, with colour only on its dot or icon (tone).

## When to use

- Several filters that can be on at once (materials, device types).
- Removable active filters above a list.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Exactly one of 2–5 options | Pills |
| A read-only status | Badge |

## Import

```tsx
import { Chip } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Toggle filters

tone colours the dot of what the chip filters; the chip itself stays neutral.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Chip } from "@semi/ui";

const MATERIALS = [
  { key: "pla", label: "PLA", tone: "green" },
  { key: "petg", label: "PETG", tone: "sky" },
  { key: "tpu", label: "TPU", tone: "pink" },
] as const;

export default function ChipToggle() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState<string[]>(["pla"]);
  const toggle = (k: string) => setOn((v) => (v.includes(k) ? v.filter((x) => x !== k) : [...v, k]));
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {MATERIALS.map((m) => (
        <Chip key={m.key} tone={m.tone} active={on.includes(m.key)} onClick={() => toggle(m.key)}>
          {m.label}
        </Chip>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Chip

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClick` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `tone` | `SemanticTone` |  | Optional theme-matching chromatic tone when active. Defaults to neutral raised surface. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- A button with aria-pressed when it toggles; keep the text short.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/chip/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/pills.md -->

# Pills

A single-choice filter of 2–5 options on one track (segmented look). The left side of a SubpageToolbar.

## When to use

- Filter a list by status or period: Tất cả / Đang in / Xong.
- Switch a small view mode with no panels.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Switch panels of content | Tabs |
| Many filters, several at once | Chip |
| Sibling pages | PageTabsTitle |
| Icon options or several on at once | ToggleGroup |

## Import

```tsx
import { Pills } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Status filter

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Pills } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PillsBasic() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  return (
    <Pills
      value={status}
      onChange={setStatus}
      options={[
        { key: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
        { key: "printing", label: "Đang in" },
        { key: "idle", label: "Chờ lệnh" },
        { key: "error", label: "Lỗi" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Pills

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `options` * | `{ key: T; label: ReactNode; title?: string \| undefined; }[]` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(v: T) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- Each option is a button with aria-pressed; Tab moves between options. For an icon set or a radio-group keyboard model use ToggleGroup.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/pills/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/toggle.md -->

# Toggle

Buttons that stay pressed. Toggle for one (pin, mute, bold); ToggleGroup for a set of icon or short options, one or several at a time (list / grid view, text styles).

## When to use

- A view mode with icons; text formatting; a pin / follow / mute switch on a toolbar.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Filter a list by text options | Pills |
| A setting saved immediately with a label | Switch |

## Import

```tsx
import { Toggle, ToggleGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Toggle

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Toggle } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ToggleBasic() {
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Toggle pressed={pinned} onPressedChange={setPinned} icon="pin">
      {pinned ? "Đã ghim" : "Ghim"}
    </Toggle>
  );
}
```

### View mode (single) and styles (multiple)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ToggleGroup } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ToggleGroupBasic() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<("grid" | "list")[]>(["grid"]);
  const [styles, setStyles] = useState<("bold" | "italic" | "code")[]>(["bold"]);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
      <ToggleGroup
        label="Chế độ xem"
        value={view}
        onChange={setView}
        options={[
          { key: "grid", icon: "grid", "aria-label": "Lưới" },
          { key: "list", icon: "menu", "aria-label": "Danh sách" },
        ]}
      />
      <ToggleGroup
        type="multiple"
        label="Kiểu chữ"
        value={styles}
        onChange={setStyles}
        options={[
          { key: "bold", label: "Đậm" },
          { key: "italic", label: "Nghiêng" },
          { key: "code", icon: "code", "aria-label": "Code" },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Toggle

One button that stays pressed (aria-pressed). Icon-only needs an aria-label.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pressed` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onPressedChange` * | `(pressed: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |

### ToggleGroup

A set of toggles on one track. type="single" (default) behaves like a radio group (←/→ move and select);
type="multiple" is a toolbar of independent toggles. Value is a list of keys in both cases.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` * | `ToggleOption<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T[]` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: T[]) => void` |  |  |
| `type` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `"single"` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Toggle uses aria-pressed. ToggleGroup type="single" is a radio group (←/→ move and select), type="multiple" a toolbar of pressed buttons. Icon-only options need aria-label.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/toggle/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/calendar.md -->

# Calendar

A month grid to pick one day or a range (YYYY-MM-DD, weeks start on Monday). DatePicker shows it in a popover; place it inline for schedules and report filters.

## When to use

- Inline date selection on a page; picking a date range for a report.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A date field in a form | DatePicker |

## Import

```tsx
import { Calendar, isoDay, parseDay, type DayRange } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### One day

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Calendar } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CalendarSingle() {
  const [day, setDay] = useState("2026-11-12");
  return <Calendar value={day} onChange={setDay} min="2026-11-01" />;
}
```

### Range

Click a start day, then an end day.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Calendar, type DayRange } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CalendarRange() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<DayRange>({ start: "2026-11-03", end: "2026-11-09" });
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Calendar mode="range" value={range} onChange={setRange} />
      <p className="text-label text-muted tabular-nums">
        {range.start ?? "…"} → {range.end ?? "…"}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Calendar

A grid of days (role="grid"): arrows move by day / week, Home / End to the start / end of the week, PageUp /
PageDown by month (Shift: by year), Enter / Space pick. Only the focused day is in the tab order.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `string` |  | Earliest / latest selectable day ("YYYY-MM-DD"). |
| `max` | `string` |  |  |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` |  | Move focus into the grid when it mounts (DatePicker does). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `mode` | `'single' \| 'range'` |  |  |
| `value` * | `string \| DayRange` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void \| (value: DayRange) => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="grid": arrows move by day / week, Home / End to the week's ends, PageUp / PageDown by month (Shift: year), Enter / Space pick; today has aria-current="date".

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/calendar/ and the types in src/ -->

# Checkbox

A native checkbox with label and description, checked fill in the accent, and an indeterminate state for “select all”.

## When to use

- Opt in to something in a form (accept terms, include archived).
- Select rows; “select all” with indeterminate.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A setting that applies at once | Switch |
| Exactly one option of a few | RadioGroup |

## Import

```tsx

```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

  return <Checkbox checked={auto} onChange={setAuto} label="Tự động in khi rảnh" description="Máy nhận job tiếp theo trong hàng đợi." />;

```

### Indeterminate and disabled

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function CheckboxStates() {

    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">

    </div>
  );
}
```

| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

<!-- docs/components/field.md -->

# Field, Input, Textarea

Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field).

## When to use

- Every form control: wrap it in Field instead of writing a <label>.
- Text, email, password, search inside forms; multi-line notes.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Numbers with a touch keypad | NumberInput |
| A date | DatePicker |
| Pick from a list | CustomSelect or CustomCombobox |
| Filter a list in a toolbar | SearchInput |

## Import

```tsx
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Label and hint

```tsx
import { Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldBasic() {
  return (
    <Field label="Tên máy in" hint="Hiện trên thẻ và trong thông báo.">
      <Input placeholder="VD: X1 Carbon xưởng A" icon="printer" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Error and required

Pass error to show the message under the control and mark it invalid.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldValidation() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("ab");
  const error = name.length > 0 && name.length < 3 ? "Tên cần ít nhất 3 ký tự." : undefined;
  return (
    <Field label="Tên dự án" required error={error}>
      <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Textarea

```tsx
import { Field, Textarea } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldTextarea() {
  return (
    <Field label="Ghi chú">
      <Textarea rows={3} placeholder="Ghi chú cho đơn in…" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

## API

### Field

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `hint` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One short helper line under the control (hidden while an error shows). |
| `error` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Error message; marks the control aria-invalid and announces the message. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### Input

Text input on the field surface (FIELD_INPUT). For numbers use NumberInput, for dates DatePicker.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Leading icon inside the field. |

### Textarea

Multi-line text on the field surface (FIELD_TEXTAREA).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Field links label (htmlFor), hint and error (aria-describedby) and sets aria-invalid on error.
- The error is announced when it appears; required adds a visible mark and aria-required.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/field/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/input-group.md -->

# Input group

An input with fixed parts around it: a prefix (https://), a unit (kg, ₫), an icon or a small button (copy, show password).

## When to use

- Money and units, URLs and domains, a copy or reveal button inside the field.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Just an icon | Input with icon |

## Import

```tsx
import { InputGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Prefix, unit and button

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, Input, InputGroup } from "@semi/ui";

export default function InputGroupAddons() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 max-w-md">
      <Field label="Website">
        <InputGroup start="https://">
          <Input placeholder="3dnoobs.vn" />
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
      <Field label="Giá bán">
        <InputGroup end="₫">
          <Input defaultValue="250.000" className="tabular-nums" />
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
      <Field label="Mật khẩu Wi-Fi máy in">
        <InputGroup end={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" iconOnly icon={show ? "eyeOff" : "eye"} aria-label={show ? "Ẩn" : "Hiện"} onClick={() => setShow((v) => !v)} />}>
          <Input type={show ? "text" : "password"} defaultValue="noobs-2026" />
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### InputGroup

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Before the input: text ("https://"), an <Icon />, a small Button. |
| `end` | `React.ReactNode` |  | After the input: a unit ("kg"), a Button (copy, show password). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | One Input (or Textarea / NumberInput). |

## Accessibility

- The Input inside keeps its label from Field; buttons in the group need their own aria-label.

<!-- docs/components/input-otp.md -->

# Input OTP

One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, SMS autofill, screen readers and the number keypad work like a normal field.

## When to use

- Verification codes, PINs, invite codes of a fixed length.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A password | Input type="password" (+ InputGroup reveal button) |

## Import

```tsx
import { InputOTP } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### 6-digit code

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, InputOTP, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function InputOTPBasic() {
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Field label="Mã xác thực" hint="Gửi tới số điện thoại ****321" error={error ? "Mã không đúng, thử lại." : undefined}>
      <InputOTP
        value={code}
        onChange={(v) => {
          setCode(v);
          setError(false);
        }}
        onComplete={(v) => (v === "123456" ? toast({ title: "Đã xác thực", tone: "success" }) : setError(true))}
        invalid={error}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

## API

### InputOTP

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onComplete` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called once every box is filled. |
| `length` | `number` | `6` |  |
| `type` | `'numeric' \| 'text'` | `"numeric"` | numeric: digits and the number keypad; text: letters and digits. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name (default “Mã xác thực”). Put a visible label in Field around it when you have one. |
| `groupSize` | `number` | `3` | Visual gap after every N boxes (0: none). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Error look (wrong code). |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A single labelled input with autocomplete="one-time-code" and inputmode="numeric"; the boxes are decoration; invalid sets aria-invalid.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/input-otp/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/number-input.md -->

# Number input

NumberInput: numbers with a touch keypad (NumPadPopup) on phones and tablets, plain typing elsewhere. Never type="number".

## When to use

- Quantities, temperatures, prices, percentages.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A range picked by dragging | a slider (coming in a later release) |

## Import

```tsx
import { NumberInput, NumPadPopup, FIELD_INPUT } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### With unit

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FIELD_INPUT, Field, NumberInput } from "@semi/ui";

export default function NumberInputBasic() {
  const [temp, setTemp] = useState("220");
  return (
    <Field label="Nhiệt độ đầu phun" hint="Trên màn hình cảm ứng mở bàn phím số.">
      <NumberInput className={FIELD_INPUT} value={temp} onChange={(e) => setTemp(e.target.value)} unit="°C" integer numpadLabel="Nhiệt độ" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

## API

### NumberInput

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  |
| `numpadLabel` | `string` |  | Title shown on the numpad (defaults to aria-label / placeholder). |
| `unit` | `string` |  | Unit shown next to the value on the numpad. |
| `integer` | `boolean` |  | Whole numbers only (no decimal key). |

### NumPadPopup

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `unit` | `string` |  |  |
| `initial` * | `string` |  |  |
| `integer` | `boolean` |  | whole numbers only |
| `allowPercent` | `boolean` |  | allow a trailing % (value like "15%") |
| `onCommit` * | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- inputMode="decimal" or numeric; the keypad is a dialog with focus trap and Escape.

Exactly one option of a few, each with an optional description; vertical by default.

```tsx
      label="Gói dịch vụ"

        { value: "pro", label: "Pro", description: "Tối đa 10 máy" },
```

<!-- docs/components/select.md -->

# Select

CustomSelect: pick one value from a list, in a field, in a toolbar, inline in a row or bare. Never the native <select>.

## When to use

- One value from a short or medium list (printers, regions).
- A compact sort / group control in a toolbar (variant="toolbar").

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A long list the user types into | CustomCombobox |
| 2–5 visible options | Pills or RadioGroup |

## Import

```tsx
import { CustomSelect } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### In a form

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { CustomSelect, Field } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SelectField() {
  const [printer, setPrinter] = useState("x1c");
  return (
    <Field label="Máy in">
      <CustomSelect
        variant="field"
        value={printer}
        onChange={setPrinter}
        options={[
          { value: "x1c", label: "Bambu Lab X1-Carbon" },
          { value: "p1s", label: "Bambu Lab P1S" },
          { value: "a1", label: "Bambu Lab A1 Mini" },
        ]}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### In a toolbar

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { CustomSelect } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SelectToolbar() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("recent");
  return (
    <CustomSelect
      variant="toolbar"
      aria-label="Sắp xếp"
      value={sort}
      onChange={setSort}
      options={[
        { value: "recent", label: "Mới nhất" },
        { value: "name", label: "Tên A–Z" },
        { value: "status", label: "Trạng thái" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### CustomSelect

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(val: string) => void` |  |  |
| `options` * | `CustomSelectOption[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `"left"` | Which edge the option list lines up with (use "right" for a select at the right edge of the screen). |
| `iconsInList` | `boolean` | `false` | Show each option's icon in the list too (default: only on the button). |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | The button shows only the selected option's icon (its label becomes the tooltip), e.g. the AI profile logo. |
| `variant` | `'toolbar' \| 'field' \| 'inline' \| 'bare'` | `"toolbar"` | toolbar = h-control toolbar control (34px in Flat) · field = full-width form field · inline = bare text inside a row · bare = no trigger styling (the caller passes it in buttonClassName, e.g. the automation code chips) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `buttonClassName` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes on the button (e.g. a "modified value" colour). |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A listbox button: Enter / Space / arrows open it, type-ahead jumps, Escape closes and returns focus.

<!-- docs/components/slider.md -->

# Slider

Pick a number in a range by dragging: one thumb, or two with range for a min–max pair.

## When to use

- Values where the position matters more than the exact number (volume, opacity, infill, price range filters).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| An exact number | NumberInput |

## Import

```tsx
import { Slider } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Single

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Slider } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SliderSingle() {
  const [infill, setInfill] = useState(20);
  return <Slider label="Độ đặc (infill)" value={infill} onChange={setInfill} step={5} showValue format={(v) => `${v}%`} className="max-w-sm" />;
}
```

### Range

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Slider } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SliderRange() {
  const [price, setPrice] = useState<[number, number]>([100, 600]);
  return (
    <Slider
      range
      label="Khoảng giá"
      value={price}
      onChange={setPrice}
      min={0}
      max={1000}
      step={50}
      showValue
      format={(v) => `${v}k ₫`}
      className="max-w-sm"
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Slider

One or two thumbs (role="slider"): ←/↓ and →/↑ step, PageUp / PageDown jump 10 steps, Home / End go to the ends;
drag or click the track. `value` is a number, or [low, high] with `range`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `number` |  |  |
| `max` | `number` |  |  |
| `step` | `number` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Visible label above the track (also the accessible name). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` |  | Show the formatted value next to the label. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | Text of a value (units, %): read by screen readers too (aria-valuetext). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `range` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `value` * | `number \| [number, number]` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: number) => void \| (value: [number, number]) => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="slider" per thumb with aria-valuenow / aria-valuetext (format): arrows step, PageUp / PageDown jump, Home / End go to the ends.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/slider/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/command.md -->

# Command

A command palette: type to filter actions and pages, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to run. Command is the inline list; CommandDialog opens it over the page, usually on ⌘K (useHotkey). Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks.

## When to use

- Jump anywhere and run any action from the keyboard (⌘K) in apps with many pages.
- A searchable action list inside a Popover.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Pick one value in a form | CustomCombobox |
| Filter the list on the page | SearchInput |

## Import

```tsx
import { Command, CommandDialog, useHotkey, filterCommands, normalizeSearch, type CommandItem } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### ⌘K palette

Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or the button; try typing “don hang” without marks.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, CommandDialog, Kbd, toast, useHotkey, type CommandItem } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CommandPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  useHotkey(() => setOpen((v) => !v));
  const go = (title: string) => () => toast({ title });
  const items: CommandItem[] = [
    { id: "orders", label: "Đơn hàng", group: "Trang", icon: "bag", onSelect: go("Mở Đơn hàng") },
    { id: "printers", label: "Máy in", group: "Trang", icon: "printer", keywords: ["printer"], onSelect: go("Mở Máy in") },
    { id: "inventory", label: "Kho vật liệu", group: "Trang", icon: "box", onSelect: go("Mở Kho") },
    { id: "new-order", label: "Tạo đơn hàng", group: "Thao tác", icon: "plus", shortcut: ["⌘", "N"], onSelect: go("Tạo đơn") },
    { id: "theme", label: "Đổi giao diện sáng / tối", group: "Thao tác", icon: "moon", onSelect: go("Đổi giao diện") },
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="search" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Tìm nhanh <Kbd keys={["⌘", "K"]} />
      </Button>
      <CommandDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} items={items} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Inline

```tsx
"use client";

import { Command, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CommandInline() {
  return (
    <div className="h-72 max-w-md rounded-card border border-line bg-panel overflow-hidden">
      <Command
        items={[
          { id: "pla", label: "PLA đen", group: "Vật liệu", icon: "box", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "PLA đen" }) },
          { id: "petg", label: "PETG trong", group: "Vật liệu", icon: "box", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "PETG trong" }) },
          { id: "x1", label: "X1 Carbon 03", group: "Máy in", icon: "printer", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "X1 Carbon 03" }) },
          { id: "a1", label: "A1 Mini 01", group: "Máy in", icon: "printer", disabled: true, onSelect: () => undefined },
        ]}
        placeholder="Tìm vật liệu, máy in…"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Command

The searchable list itself (inside a page, a Popover or CommandDialog). The input is an ARIA combobox that owns a
listbox; the active option follows aria-activedescendant so focus never leaves the input.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `CommandItem[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `emptyText` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown when nothing matches (default from the locale). |
| `onEscape` | `() => void` |  | Escape on an empty query (CommandDialog closes). |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### CommandDialog

The command palette over the page: a modal dialog near the top, closed by Escape, a click outside or a pick.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onOpenChange` * | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `items` * | `CommandItem[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `emptyText` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The input is an ARIA combobox owning a listbox (aria-activedescendant), so focus stays in the input; groups are labelled; the dialog traps focus and Escape closes it.

<!-- docs/components/confirm-dialog.md -->

# Confirm dialog

confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false. Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm.

## When to use

- Before deleting, stopping a print or discarding changes.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A form or several fields | Modal |
| Undo instead of asking | toast() with an action |

## Import

```tsx
import { ConfirmHost, confirmDialog } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Destructive confirmation

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, confirmDialog } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ConfirmDanger() {
  const [result, setResult] = useState("");
  const remove = async () => {
    const ok = await confirmDialog({
      title: "Xoá bản in mẫu?",
      message: "Tệp G-code và dữ liệu lát cắt sẽ bị xoá vĩnh viễn.",
      confirmLabel: "Xoá",
      tone: "danger",
    });
    setResult(ok ? "Đã xoá" : "Đã huỷ");
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <Button variant="danger" icon="trash" onClick={remove}>
        Xoá bản in
      </Button>
      {result && <span className="text-label text-muted">{result}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ConfirmHost

Mounted once in the root layout; renders the dialog opened by `confirmDialog()`.

No props of its own.

## Accessibility

- An alertdialog: focus starts on the safe button (Huỷ), Escape cancels.

## Notes

- <ConfirmHost /> goes once in the root layout (see Theme › Root layout); confirmDialog() works from any event handler.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/confirm-dialog/ and the types in src/ -->


---

<!-- docs/components/context-menu.md -->

# Context menu

The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus.

## When to use

- Power-user shortcuts on canvases, file grids and rows, when the same actions also exist in a visible Menu or toolbar.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| The only way to reach an action | Menu (visible trigger) |

## Import

```tsx
import { ContextMenu } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### On a file card

```tsx
import { ContextMenu, IconTile, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ContextMenuFile() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu
      label="Thao tác tệp"
      items={[
        { label: "Mở", icon: "external", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở tệp" }) },
        { label: "Nhân bản", icon: "copy", shortcut: "⌘D", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã nhân bản", tone: "success" }) },
        { label: "Xoá", icon: "trash", danger: true, separator: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã xoá", tone: "danger" }) },
      ]}
    >
      <div className="flex w-64 items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-field p-3">
        <IconTile name="fileCode" tone="sky" />
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-ui font-medium text-contrast truncate">vo-hop-dieu-khien.gcode</div>
          <div className="text-caption text-muted">Chuột phải (hoặc giữ) để mở menu</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}
```

## API

### ContextMenu

The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the
area has focus. Use for power-user shortcuts that also exist elsewhere (a row's Menu, a toolbar button).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `MenuItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the menu. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The area that opens the menu (it becomes focusable). |

## Accessibility

- The area is focusable; Menu key / Shift+F10 open the menu, which behaves like Menu (arrows, Escape returns focus).

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/context-menu/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/drawer.md -->

# Drawer

A panel that slides in from the right, left, bottom or top (a sheet), with title and footer.

## When to use

- Filters of a list, details of a row, a secondary form that keeps the page visible.
- A sheet from the top (announcements, a global search) with side="top".

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A focused task | Modal |
| A persistent tool panel beside a canvas | SidePanel |

## Import

```tsx
import { Drawer } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Filters

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Checkbox, Drawer, Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function DrawerFilters() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(true);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="filter" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Bộ lọc
      </Button>
      <Drawer
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="Bộ lọc"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button size="modal" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Huỷ
            </Button>
            <Button size="modal" variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Áp dụng
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <Field label="Từ khoá">
          <Input placeholder="Tên, mã đơn…" icon="search" />
        </Field>
        <Checkbox checked={online} onChange={setOnline} label="Chỉ máy đang online" />
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Sides

side picks the edge: right (default), left, bottom (phone-style sheet) or top.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Drawer } from "@semi/ui";

type Side = "right" | "left" | "bottom" | "top";

export default function DrawerSides() {
  const [side, setSide] = useState<Side | null>(null);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {(["right", "left", "bottom", "top"] as const).map((s) => (
        <Button key={s} onClick={() => setSide(s)}>
          {s}
        </Button>
      ))}
      <Drawer open={side !== null} onClose={() => setSide(null)} side={side ?? "right"} title={`Sheet: ${side ?? ""}`}>
        <p className="text-ui text-body">Nội dung phụ, trang bên dưới vẫn giữ nguyên.</p>
      </Drawer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Drawer

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `side` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `"right"` | right (default) / left: side sheet; bottom: phone-style sheet; top: a sheet from the top (announcements, search). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Actions pinned to the bottom (MODAL_FOOT). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Width override for side drawers (e.g. "sm:max-w-lg"). |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A modal dialog: focus trap, Escape, focus returns to the opener; the title labels it.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/drawer/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/hover-card.md -->

# Hover card

A preview card while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, a link: a person, a product, an order.

## When to use

- Peek at a linked record without opening it.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Anything people must act on | Popover (click) |
| A one-line label | Tooltip |

## Import

```tsx
import { HoverCard } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Person

```tsx
import { Avatar, Badge, HoverCard } from "@semi/ui";

export default function HoverCardUser() {
  return (
    <p className="text-ui text-body">
      Đơn được duyệt bởi{" "}
      <HoverCard
        trigger={
          <a href="#minh-anh" className="font-medium text-accent-fg underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
            Minh Anh
          </a>
        }
      >
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <Avatar name="Minh Anh" />
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="text-ui font-semibold text-contrast">Minh Anh</div>
            <div className="text-label text-muted">Quản lý xưởng · Khu A</div>
            <Badge tone="emerald" dot size="sm">
              Đang trực
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </div>
      </HoverCard>
      .
    </p>
  );
}
```

## API

### HoverCard

A preview card while the pointer rests on (or keyboard focus is on) its trigger, usually a link. It adds detail
only: touch screens never show it, so the link must work without it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` * | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  | A link or button; it keeps its own name and action. |
| `openDelay` | `number` | `400` |  |
| `closeDelay` | `number` | `150` |  |
| `width` | `number` | `260` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Opens on hover and keyboard focus, closes on Escape; touch screens never show it, so the link must work alone.

<!-- docs/components/menu.md -->

# Menu

The overflow menu of a row or card: a ⋯ trigger (or your own) with items, icons, separators and a danger item last.

## When to use

- Secondary actions of a row or card (Đổi tên, Nhân bản, Xoá).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| One or two visible actions | Button |
| Pick a value | CustomSelect |

## Import

```tsx
import { Menu } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Row actions

```tsx
"use client";

import { Menu, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function MenuRowActions() {
  return (
    <Menu
      label="Thao tác máy in"
      items={[
        { label: "Đổi tên", icon: "edit", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đổi tên" }) },
        { label: "Nhân bản", icon: "copy", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã nhân bản", tone: "success" }) },
        { label: "Tạm dừng", icon: "pause", onSelect: () => undefined, disabled: true },
        { label: "Xoá", icon: "trash", danger: true, separator: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Không xoá được", description: "Máy đang in.", tone: "danger" }) },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Menu

Action menu behind a trigger button (row / card overflow actions). ↑/↓ move, Enter / Space pick, Escape closes and
returns focus. Default trigger: icon-only "more" button; pass `trigger` (an element) to use your own.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `MenuItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the default trigger. |
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `"right"` |  |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="menu": Enter / Space / ↓ open, arrows move, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/menu/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/modal.md -->

# Modal

The shared dialog: full screen on phones, a centred panel from sm up, with title, description, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener.

## When to use

- A short task that needs the user's full attention (edit settings, create an item).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Yes / no before a destructive action | confirmDialog() |
| Filters or details beside the page | Drawer |
| A short message after an action | toast() |

## Import

```tsx
import { Modal } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Form in a modal

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, Input, Modal } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ModalBasic() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="sliders" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Cấu hình in
      </Button>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="Cấu hình in nâng cao"
        description="Áp dụng cho các bản in tiếp theo."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button size="modal" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Huỷ
            </Button>
            <Button size="modal" variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Lưu
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <Field label="Tốc độ lớp đầu">
          <Input defaultValue="50 mm/s" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Độ dày lớp">
          <Input defaultValue="0.20 mm" />
        </Field>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
```

## API

### Modal

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional one-line description under the title (announced with the dialog). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Action buttons rendered inside MODAL_FOOT (use MODAL_BTN_PRIMARY / MODAL_BTN_SECONDARY / MODAL_BTN_DANGER or <Button size="modal">). |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | `"max-w-lg"` | Width class on >= sm screens (e.g. "max-w-md", "max-w-lg", "max-w-2xl"). |
| `closeOnBackdrop` | `boolean` | `true` | Close when the backdrop is clicked (turn off for forms that would lose input). |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="dialog" + aria-modal, labelled by the title; Escape and the close button close it; focus trap and focus return built in; page scroll is locked.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/modal/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/popover.md -->

# Popover

A small non-modal panel under its trigger for interactive content: a quick form, filters, a picker.

## When to use

- Quick edits without leaving the page (rename, set a limit), compact filter forms.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A list of actions | Menu |
| A focused multi-step task | Modal |
| A read-only preview on hover | HoverCard |
| A one-line hint | Tooltip |

## Import

```tsx
import { Popover } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Quick edit

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, Input, Popover } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PopoverQuickEdit() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("X1 Carbon 03");
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(name);
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <span className="text-ui font-medium text-contrast">{name}</span>
      <Popover
        label="Đổi tên máy in"
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={(o) => {
          setOpen(o);
          if (o) setDraft(name);
        }}
        trigger={<Button size="sm" icon="edit">Đổi tên</Button>}
      >
        <form
          className="space-y-3"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setName(draft);
            setOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          <Field label="Tên máy in">
            <Input value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Huỷ
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="primary" type="submit">
              Lưu
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Popover>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Popover

A non-modal dialog under its trigger. Focus moves into it; Escape, a click outside or tabbing out closes it, and
Escape returns focus to the trigger. Controlled with `open` + `onOpenChange`, or on its own.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` * | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  | The element that toggles it (usually a Button). |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the panel. |
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'center'` | `"left"` |  |
| `width` | `number` | `280` | Minimum width in px (it grows with its content up to the viewport). |
| `open` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A labelled dialog: focus moves in, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger, clicking outside or tabbing out closes it.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/popover/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/toast.md -->

# Toast

toast() shows a short message after an action, with a tone and an optional action (Hoàn tác). Mount ToastHost once in the root layout.

## When to use

- Confirm an action happened (Đã lưu), warn about something passing (mất kết nối), offer undo.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A message that must stay on the page | Alert |
| Ask before acting | confirmDialog() |

## Import

```tsx
import { ToastHost, toast, dismissToast } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tones and actions

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ToastTones() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <Button onClick={() => toast({ title: "Đã lưu thay đổi", tone: "success", action: { label: "Hoàn tác", onClick: () => toast({ title: "Đã hoàn tác" }) } })}>
        Thành công + hoàn tác
      </Button>
      <Button onClick={() => toast({ title: "Mất kết nối máy in", description: "Thử lại sau vài giây.", tone: "warning" })}>Cảnh báo</Button>
      <Button onClick={() => toast({ title: "Tệp sẽ được gửi khi máy rảnh", tone: "info", duration: 0 })}>Không tự tắt</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ToastHost

Toast stack: top on phones (clear of the tab bar), bottom-right from sm.

No props of its own.

## Accessibility

- A live region (polite, assertive for danger); toasts with an action stay until dismissed or wait longer.

## Notes

- <ToastHost /> goes once in the root layout (see Theme › Root layout); every toast() call anywhere shows there.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/toast/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/tooltip.md -->

# Tooltip

A short label on hover or focus, mostly for icon-only buttons.

## When to use

- Name an icon-only control; add a short hint to a truncated value.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Information people must read | visible text or an Alert |

## Import

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### On an icon button

```tsx
import { Button, Tooltip } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TooltipIconButton() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <Tooltip content="Đồng bộ lại dữ liệu">
        <Button iconOnly icon="refresh" aria-label="Làm mới" />
      </Tooltip>
      <Tooltip content="Tải báo cáo" side="bottom">
        <Button iconOnly icon="download" aria-label="Tải báo cáo" />
      </Tooltip>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Tooltip

Short hint for an icon-only control (one line, no interactive content). The trigger keeps its own aria-label;
the tooltip is linked with aria-describedby. Touch screens show nothing: never put essential text in a tooltip.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` * | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  |  |
| `side` | `'bottom' \| 'top'` | `"top"` |  |

## Accessibility

- Shown on focus too, linked with aria-describedby; never the only place of essential information.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/tooltip/ and the types in src/ -->
