<!-- docs/components/app-header.md -->

# App header

The top bar of a stand-alone tool app: logo + title go home, the module name, and one primary action on the right. No Home button.

## When to use

- Single-screen tools: 3D editors, slicers, colour tools.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| An app with several pages | AppShell |

## Import

```tsx
import { AppHeader, HEADER_ICON_BTN, HEADER_ICON_OFF, headerPrimary } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tool app

```tsx
import { AppHeader, HEADER_ICON_BTN, HEADER_ICON_OFF, Icon, headerPrimary } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AppHeaderTool() {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-card border border-line overflow-hidden">
      <AppHeader title="Phối màu" productName="3D Noobs" logoIcon="palette" homeHref="#">
        <button type="button" className={`${HEADER_ICON_BTN} ${HEADER_ICON_OFF}`} aria-label="Trợ lý AI" title="Trợ lý AI">
          <Icon name="sparkles" className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
        <button type="button" className={headerPrimary(true)}>
          Xong
        </button>
      </AppHeader>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### AppHeader

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` |  | Stand-alone app title; without it the bar is the home page's logo bar. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Right-hand side (app actions). Wrap in a `flex-1` element to centre something. |
| `onHome` | `() => void` |  | Click on the logo + title. Default: plain link to `/`. |
| `hideTitleOnPhone` | `boolean` | `false` | Only the logo on phones (dense toolbars). |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `productName` | `string` | `"Semi"` | Product name shown on the home bar (no `title`). |
| `logo` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Custom logo node; replaces the default icon tile. |
| `logoIcon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` | Icon of the default logo tile. |
| `homeHref` | `string` | `"/"` | Where the logo + title link goes. |
| `homeLabel` | `string` |  | Tooltip / aria text of the logo link. |

## Accessibility

- A banner landmark; the home link is labelled; icon buttons need aria-label.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/app-header/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/app-shell.md -->

# App shell

The frame of a multi-page app: a floating bento sidebar (w-52, collapses to a w-14 icon rail) on bg-canvas, the content panel beside it, and MobileTabBar at the bottom on phones. This docs site is an AppShell.

## When to use

- Every app with several pages (dashboards, admin, store back office).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A single-screen tool or editor (3D, canvas) | AppHeader |

## Import

```tsx
import { AppShell, MobileTabBar } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Root layout

AppShell fills the viewport, so it is shown as code: this very page is the live example.

```tsx
"use client";

import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { AppShell, ThemeSwitcher, type ShellNavSection } from "@semi/ui";

const SECTIONS: ShellNavSection[] = [
  {
    label: "Quản lý",
    items: [
      { id: "overview", label: "Tổng quan", icon: "grid", href: "/" },
      { id: "printers", label: "Máy in", icon: "printer", href: "/printers" },
      { id: "orders", label: "Đơn hàng", icon: "bag", href: "/orders" },
    ],
  },
  { label: "Hệ thống", items: [{ id: "settings", label: "Cài đặt", icon: "settings", href: "/settings" }] },
];

export default function Shell({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const path = usePathname();
  const active = SECTIONS.flatMap((s) => s.items).find((i) => i.href !== "/" && path.startsWith(i.href ?? ""))?.id ?? "overview";
  return (
    <AppShell productName="3D Noobs Manager" logoIcon="printer" sections={SECTIONS} activeId={active} footer={() => <ThemeSwitcher fullWidth />}>
      {children}
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

## API

### AppShell

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `productName` * | `string` |  | Product title shown in the sidebar header (e.g. "3D Noobs Studio", "Auton"). |
| `logoIcon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` | Icon inside the default 24x24 brand tile. |
| `logo` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional custom logo element replacing the default brand tile. |
| `sections` * | `ShellNavSection[]` |  | Navigation groups separated by thin dividers in the left panel. |
| `activeId` * | `string` |  | Currently active item id (or route path). |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Callback when a tab is clicked (optional if items use `href` routing). |
| `primaryCta` | `{ label: string; icon: IconName; href?: string; external?: boolean; onClick?: () => void; }` |  | Optional highlighted CTA button at the top of the sidebar (e.g. Slicer launcher). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode \| ((state: { collapsed: boolean }) => React.ReactNode)` |  | Footer content at the bottom of the sidebar. Receives `{ collapsed }` so it can hide text in rail mode. |
| `mobileTabIds` | `string[]` |  | Up to 5 item ids to pin on the phone bottom tab bar (defaults to the first 5 items). |
| `storageKey` | `string` | `"semi_sidebar_collapsed"` | localStorage key for persisting sidebar collapsed state. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `containerClassName` | `string` | `""` |  |

### MobileTabBar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` * | `MobileTabItem[]` |  |  |
| `active` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| `moreOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | When the app has more routes than fit on the bottom bar, show a final "Menu" tab that opens a sheet. |
| `onToggleMore` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `moreLabel` | `string` | `"Menu"` |  |

## Accessibility

- The sidebar is a nav landmark; the active item has aria-current; the collapse state is remembered per app (storageKey).

## Notes

- Render it once in the root layout (or a route group layout); pages render only their content.
- Use next/link hrefs for items; onSelect is for in-page sections.
- MobileTabBar is used by AppShell; render it yourself only in a custom shell.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/app-shell/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/breadcrumb.md -->

# Breadcrumb

Where the page sits: a trail of links ending with the current page. Long trails collapse their middle into a “…” menu.

## When to use

- Detail pages deep in a hierarchy (Kho › Vật liệu › PLA đen).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Top-level pages of an app | AppShell navigation |
| Sibling views | PageTabsTitle |

## Import

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Trail

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from "@semi/ui";

export default function BreadcrumbBasic() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      items={[
        { label: "Kho", href: "/inventory", icon: "box" },
        { label: "Vật liệu", href: "/inventory/materials" },
        { label: "PLA đen 1kg" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Collapsed

More items than maxItems keep the first and the last two; the rest open from “…”.

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from "@semi/ui";

export default function BreadcrumbCollapsed() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      maxItems={3}
      items={[
        { label: "Xưởng", href: "/" },
        { label: "Khu A", href: "/a" },
        { label: "Dãy 2", href: "/a/2" },
        { label: "Máy in", href: "/a/2/printers" },
        { label: "X1 Carbon 03" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Breadcrumb

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `BreadcrumbItem[]` |  |  |
| `maxItems` | `number` | `4` | More items than this collapse the middle ones into a "…" menu (first + last two stay). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A nav landmark (“Đường dẫn”) with an ordered list; the last item has aria-current="page".

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/breadcrumb/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/menubar.md -->

# Menubar

The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): menus that open from a bar and behave like Menu.

## When to use

- Editors and tool apps with many commands (3D, slicer, image tools), next to an AppHeader.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Page navigation | NavigationMenu or AppShell |
| A few actions | Buttons or one Menu |

## Import

```tsx
import { Menubar, type MenubarMenu } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Editor menus

```tsx
import { Menubar, toast } from "@semi/ui";

const run = (title: string) => () => toast({ title });

export default function MenubarEditor() {
  return (
    <Menubar
      label="Lệnh của trình chỉnh sửa"
      menus={[
        {
          label: "Tệp",
          items: [
            { label: "Mở…", icon: "folderOpen", shortcut: "⌘O", onSelect: run("Mở tệp") },
            { label: "Lưu", icon: "check", shortcut: "⌘S", onSelect: run("Đã lưu") },
            { label: "Xuất G-code", icon: "download", separator: true, onSelect: run("Xuất G-code") },
          ],
        },
        {
          label: "Sửa",
          items: [
            { label: "Hoàn tác", shortcut: "⌘Z", onSelect: run("Hoàn tác") },
            { label: "Làm lại", shortcut: "⇧⌘Z", onSelect: run("Làm lại"), disabled: true },
          ],
        },
        {
          label: "Xem",
          items: [
            { label: "Vừa khung hình", icon: "focus", onSelect: run("Vừa khung hình") },
            { label: "Hiện lưới", icon: "grid", onSelect: run("Hiện lưới") },
          ],
        },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Menubar

The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): ←/→ move between menus (and switch the open one), ↓ / Enter
open, the menus behave like Menu. For page navigation use NavigationMenu or AppShell instead.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menus` * | `MenubarMenu[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="menubar": ←/→ move between menus (and switch the open one), ↓ / Enter open, Escape closes and returns focus; one tab stop for the bar.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/menubar/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/navigation-menu.md -->

# Navigation menu

Top navigation of a website or landing page: links, and items that open a panel of links with descriptions. Below md it becomes one menu button with a sheet.

## When to use

- Marketing sites, storefronts, docs headers.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Navigation of an app with many pages | AppShell |
| Commands of a tool (Tệp, Sửa) | Menubar |

## Import

```tsx
import { NavigationMenu, type NavigationItem } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Site header

```tsx
import { NavigationMenu } from "@semi/ui";

export default function NavigationMenuSite() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-card border border-line bg-panel px-3 py-2">
      <span className="text-ui font-semibold text-contrast">3D Noobs</span>
      <NavigationMenu
        label="Điều hướng chính"
        current="/pricing"
        items={[
          {
            label: "Sản phẩm",
            links: [
              { label: "In theo yêu cầu", href: "/print", description: "Gửi file, nhận bản in trong 48 giờ", icon: "printer" },
              { label: "Vật liệu", href: "/materials", description: "PLA, PETG, TPU và nhựa kỹ thuật", icon: "box" },
              { label: "Studio", href: "/studio", description: "Thiết kế và lát cắt ngay trên web", icon: "sparkles" },
            ],
          },
          { label: "Bảng giá", href: "/pricing" },
          { label: "Liên hệ", href: "/contact" },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### NavigationMenu

Disclosure navigation (buttons with aria-expanded, not an ARIA menu): Enter / Space / ↓ open a panel, Escape closes
it and returns focus, a click outside closes it; the current page link gets aria-current.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `NavigationItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the nav ("Điều hướng chính"). |
| `current` | `string` |  | href of the current page (marked with aria-current="page"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A nav landmark with disclosure buttons (aria-expanded), not an ARIA menu: Tab moves through links, Escape closes a panel and returns focus; the current page link has aria-current.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/navigation-menu/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/page-actions.md -->

# Page actions

Lets a page put its actions into a slot of the shared header: PageActionsProvider wraps the layout, PageActionsSlot marks where they render, PageActions sends them from the page.

## When to use

- A layout owns the header row but the page decides the actions (PageTabsTitle + “+”).

## Import

```tsx
import { PageActions, PageActionsProvider, PageActionsSlot } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Actions in the header slot

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, PageActions, PageActionsProvider, PageActionsSlot, PageTabsTitle } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageActionsSlotExample() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<"printers" | "jobs">("printers");
  return (
    <PageActionsProvider>
      <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
        <PageTabsTitle
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
          tabs={[
            { key: "printers", label: "Máy in" },
            { key: "jobs", label: "Job in" },
          ]}
        />
        <PageActionsSlot className="ml-auto" />
      </div>
      {/* Declared by the page content, shown in the slot above */}
      <PageActions>
        <Button variant="primary" iconOnly icon="plus" aria-label={view === "printers" ? "Thêm máy in" : "Tạo job"} />
      </PageActions>
    </PageActionsProvider>
  );
}
```

## API

### PageActions

Renders its children in the page header slot (inline when the page has no slot).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### PageActionsProvider

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### PageActionsSlot

Where the actions appear: the right end of the page header row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- Rendered through a portal into the slot, so tab order follows the header.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/page-actions/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/page-title.md -->

# Page title

PageTitle is the large display title of a page (text only). PageTabsTitle turns it into 2–4 underline tabs for sibling pages.

## When to use

- The first line of every page (PageTitle).
- 2–4 sibling views of one area: Máy in / Job in (PageTabsTitle).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Tabs inside a card or panel | Tabs |
| A filter | Pills |

## Import

```tsx
import { PageTitle, PageTabsTitle } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### PageTitle

```tsx
import { PageTitle } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageTitleBasic() {
  return <PageTitle title="Máy in" />;
}
```

### PageTabsTitle

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { PageTabsTitle } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageTabsTitleBasic() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<"printers" | "jobs">("printers");
  return (
    <PageTabsTitle
      value={view}
      onChange={setView}
      tabs={[
        { key: "printers", label: "Máy in" },
        { key: "jobs", label: "Job in" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### PageTitle

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

### PageTabsTitle

Underline display tabs used when a view groups 2–4 sibling sub-pages (e.g. "Máy in / Job in", "Sản phẩm / Danh mục").
Replaces putting a separate <Pills> bar directly under a <PageTitle>.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` * | `PageTabOption<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(key: T) => void` |  |  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- PageTitle is the page h1. PageTabsTitle is a tablist with arrow-key navigation.

## Notes

- No subtitle under the title and no text buttons on the title row: actions go to PageActions or the toolbar.

# Pagination

Page numbers with previous / next for long tables. For card lists prefer auto-loading with “Xem thêm”.

## When to use

- Server-paged tables and reports.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A feed or card grid | auto-load near the end + a “Xem thêm” Button |

## Import

```tsx
import { Pagination, pageWindow } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Basic

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Pagination } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PaginationBasic() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(3);
  return <Pagination page={page} pages={12} onChange={setPage} />;
}
```

## API

### Pagination

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` * | `number` |  | Current page, 1-based. |
| `pages` * | `number` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(page: number) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- A nav landmark; the current page has aria-current="page"; arrows are labelled.

<!-- docs/components/resizable.md -->

# Resizable panels

Panels side by side or stacked with handles to resize them (an editor beside a preview, a list beside details). Sizes are percentages and can be remembered.

## When to use

- Tools where people tune the space between two or three areas.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A collapsible tool panel beside a canvas | SidePanel |
| A temporary detail view | Drawer |

## Import

```tsx
import { ResizablePanels } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### List and details

```tsx
import { ResizablePanels } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ResizableEditor() {
  return (
    <ResizablePanels defaultSizes={[35, 65]} className="h-64">
      <div className="p-4 text-label text-muted">Danh sách đơn</div>
      <div className="p-4 text-label text-muted">Chi tiết đơn đang chọn</div>
    </ResizablePanels>
  );
}
```

### Stacked, three panels

```tsx
import { ResizablePanels } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ResizableVertical() {
  return (
    <ResizablePanels direction="vertical" defaultSizes={[50, 30, 20]} className="h-80">
      <div className="p-4 text-label text-muted">Khung xem 3D</div>
      <div className="p-4 text-label text-muted">Lớp</div>
      <div className="p-4 text-label text-muted">Nhật ký</div>
    </ResizablePanels>
  );
}
```

## API

### ResizablePanels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `"horizontal"` |  |
| `defaultSizes` | `number[]` |  | Starting sizes in %, one per panel (default: equal). |
| `minSize` | `number` | `15` | Smallest size of a panel in %. |
| `storageKey` | `string` |  | Remember the sizes in localStorage under this key. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Height for direction="vertical" (e.g. "h-96"). |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | One child per panel (2 or more). |

## Accessibility

- Each handle is a focusable separator with aria-valuenow; ←/→ (↑/↓ when stacked) resize, Shift for bigger steps.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/resizable/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/scroll-area.md -->

# Scroll area

A fixed-size scrolling region (a long list in a card, a log). Semi hides scrollbars, so it marks the edges that have more content, can show a thin scrollbar, and is reachable by keyboard.

## When to use

- A list or log inside a card that must keep its height.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A wide table | Table (scrolls sideways by itself) |

## Import

```tsx
import { ScrollArea } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Log in a card

```tsx
import { Card, ScrollArea } from "@semi/ui";

const LINES = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => `12:${String(i).padStart(2, "0")}  Lớp ${i + 120}/310 · đầu phun 220°C`);

export default function ScrollAreaLog() {
  return (
    <Card className="p-0 max-w-md">
      <ScrollArea label="Nhật ký in" className="h-48">
        <ul className="p-3 space-y-1 text-label text-body tabular-nums">
          {LINES.map((l) => (
            <li key={l}>{l}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </ScrollArea>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## API

### ScrollArea

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the region (it is focusable when it scrolls, so keyboard users can scroll it). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| 'both'` | `"vertical"` |  |
| `scrollbar` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a thin scrollbar (hidden everywhere else in Semi). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Give it a size here: "h-64", "max-h-80", "w-full". |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A labelled region that becomes focusable when it scrolls, so arrow keys scroll it.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/scroll-area/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/side-panel.md -->

# Side panel

A 320px tool panel beside a canvas that collapses to a 48px rail; SidePanelToggle is its collapse button.

## When to use

- Settings or layers beside a 3D view, map or editor.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Temporary filters or details | Drawer |

## Import

```tsx
import { SidePanel, SidePanelToggle } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Beside a canvas

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { SidePanel, SidePanelToggle, Skeleton } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SidePanelCanvas() {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="h-64 flex rounded-card border border-line overflow-hidden bg-canvas">
      <SidePanel collapsed={collapsed} onToggleCollapse={() => setCollapsed((v) => !v)}>
        <div className="p-3 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-label font-medium text-muted">Cài đặt lát cắt</span>
            <SidePanelToggle onClick={() => setCollapsed(true)} />
          </div>
          <Skeleton className="h-8" />
          <Skeleton className="h-8" />
        </div>
      </SidePanel>
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-label text-muted">Canvas / 3D view</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### SidePanel

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `collapsed` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onToggleCollapse` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `width` | `number` | `SIDE_PANEL_WIDTH` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### SidePanelToggle

The collapse toggle placed at the top of the panel content (next to the first label).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onClick` * | `() => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The toggle is labelled from the locale and keeps focus; the collapsed rail stays reachable.

<!-- docs/components/subpage-toolbar.md -->

# Subpage toolbar

The sticky row under a page title: filters on the left; search, refresh and the icon-only primary action on the right. RefreshButton spins while its promise runs.

## When to use

- Every list or grid page.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Actions of a tool app | AppHeader |

## Import

```tsx
import { SubpageToolbar, RefreshButton } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### List page

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Pills, SubpageToolbar, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SubpageToolbarListPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  return (
    <SubpageToolbar
      left={
        <Pills
          value={status}
          onChange={setStatus}
          options={[
            { key: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
            { key: "printing", label: "Đang in" },
            { key: "idle", label: "Chờ lệnh" },
          ]}
        />
      }
      searchValue={q}
      onSearchChange={setQ}
      searchPlaceholder="Tìm máy in…"
      onRefresh={() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800))}
      onPrimaryAction={() => toast({ title: "Thêm máy in" })}
      primaryActionLabel="Thêm máy in"
    />
  );
}
```

### RefreshButton

```tsx
import { RefreshButton } from "@semi/ui";

export default function RefreshButtonBasic() {
  return <RefreshButton onRefresh={() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000))} />;
}
```

## API

### SubpageToolbar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `left` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Filter controls on the left (Pills, Chip, CustomSelect). |
| `right` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional extra controls on the right (placed before the primary icon button). |
| `onPrimaryAction` | `() => void` |  | Click handler for the icon-only primary CTA button (e.g. "Thêm"). |
| `primaryActionLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible title & aria-label for the icon-only primary CTA button. |
| `primaryActionIcon` | `IconName` | `"plus"` | Icon for the primary CTA button (default: "plus"). |
| `searchValue` | `string` |  | Search query value (renders a SearchInput when onSearchChange is provided). |
| `onSearchChange` | `(val: string) => void` |  | Search change handler. |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` |  | Placeholder for SearchInput. |
| `onRefresh` | `() => unknown` |  | Async or sync reload callback (renders RefreshButton when provided). |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

### RefreshButton

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onRefresh` * | `() => unknown` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The primary action is icon-only, so primaryActionLabel is required (aria-label + title).

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/subpage-toolbar/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/tabs.md -->

# Tabs

Switch between panels of content inside a page or card: underline (default) or segmented, with icons and counts.

## When to use

- Sections of one object: Tổng quan / Hoạt động / Cài đặt.
- A segmented period switch that changes a panel (variant="segmented").

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Sibling pages of an area | PageTabsTitle |
| Filter a list (no panels) | Pills |

## Import

```tsx
import { Tabs } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Underline with panels

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Tabs } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TabsUnderline() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"overview" | "activity" | "settings">("overview");
  return (
    <Tabs
      label="Chi tiết máy in"
      value={tab}
      onChange={setTab}
      items={[
        { key: "overview", label: "Tổng quan", icon: "gauge", content: <p className="text-ui text-body">Nhiệt độ, tiến độ và camera.</p> },
        { key: "activity", label: "Hoạt động", count: 12, content: <p className="text-ui text-body">12 sự kiện trong 24 giờ qua.</p> },
        { key: "settings", label: "Cài đặt", icon: "settings", content: <p className="text-ui text-body">Tên, nhóm và quyền truy cập.</p> },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Segmented

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Tabs } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TabsSegmented() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<"day" | "week" | "month">("week");
  return (
    <Tabs
      variant="segmented"
      label="Khoảng thời gian"
      value={range}
      onChange={setRange}
      items={[
        { key: "day", label: "Ngày" },
        { key: "week", label: "Tuần" },
        { key: "month", label: "Tháng" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Tabs

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `TabItem<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(key: T) => void` |  |  |
| `variant` | `'underline' \| 'segmented'` | `"underline"` | underline = section tabs inside a card or page · segmented = compact switch inside a toolbar. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tab list. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `panelClassName` | `string` | `"pt-4"` |  |

## Accessibility

- tablist / tab / tabpanel; ←/→, Home, End move; the panel is linked to its tab.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/tabs/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/accordion.md -->

# Accordion

A list of sections where one (or several) open at a time: FAQs, settings groups, help.

## When to use

- FAQs and help; long settings split into groups.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| One section | Collapsible |
| Switch whole panels | Tabs |

## Import

```tsx
import { Accordion } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### FAQ

```tsx
import { Accordion } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AccordionFaq() {
  return (
    <Accordion
      defaultValue={["petg"]}
      items={[
        { key: "petg", title: "Vì sao PETG bị kéo sợi?", content: "Giảm nhiệt độ 5–10°C, tăng retraction và bật Z-hop." },
        { key: "warp", title: "Bản in bị cong góc?", content: "Lau bàn bằng cồn, dùng brim 5 mm và tắt quạt ở 3 lớp đầu." },
        { key: "clog", title: "Đầu phun bị tắc phải làm sao?", content: "Chạy cold pull 2–3 lần; nếu vẫn tắc, thay đầu phun." },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Several open

```tsx
import { Accordion } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AccordionMultiple() {
  return (
    <Accordion
      type="multiple"
      defaultValue={["network", "storage"]}
      items={[
        { key: "network", title: "Mạng", content: "Wi-Fi: Xuong-A · IP 192.168.1.42" },
        { key: "storage", title: "Bộ nhớ", content: "Đã dùng 12,4 / 32 GB" },
        { key: "firmware", title: "Firmware", content: "1.08 (mới nhất)", disabled: true },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Accordion

A list of sections, one (type="single", default) or several (type="multiple") open at a time. ↑/↓ move between
headers, Home / End jump; each header is a button inside a heading (level), its panel a labelled region.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `AccordionItem[]` |  |  |
| `type` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `"single"` |  |
| `value` | `string[]` |  | Open item keys (controlled). |
| `defaultValue` | `string[]` | `[]` |  |
| `onChange` | `(open: string[]) => void` |  |  |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` | Heading level of the headers in the page outline. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Each header is a button inside a heading (headingLevel), with aria-expanded; ↑/↓ Home End move between headers; panels are labelled regions.

<!-- docs/components/aspect-ratio.md -->

# Aspect ratio

Keeps media at a fixed ratio while its width follows the layout (images, video, maps, 3D previews).

## When to use

- Thumbnails and media that must not jump while loading.

## Import

```tsx
import { AspectRatio } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### 16:9 and square

```tsx
import { AspectRatio } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AspectRatioBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 grid-cols-2 max-w-md">
      <AspectRatio className="rounded-card border border-line bg-field">
        <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-label text-muted">16 : 9</div>
      </AspectRatio>
      <AspectRatio ratio={1} className="rounded-card border border-line bg-field">
        <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-label text-muted">1 : 1</div>
      </AspectRatio>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### AspectRatio

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ratio` | `number` | `16 / 9` | Width / height: 16 / 9 (default), 4 / 3, 1, 3 / 4. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Radius / border / background of the frame. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Usually an <img> or <video> with "w-full h-full object-cover". |

## Accessibility

- A plain wrapper; give the image its own alt text.

<!-- docs/components/badge.md -->

# Badge

A read-only status or tag in a tone (10% fill, 20% border, theme-safe text), with an optional dot or icon.

## When to use

- Status of a row or card (Đã thanh toán, Lỗi), a plan or role tag.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Something clickable | Chip |
| A count next to a title | COUNT_PILL |

## Import

```tsx
import { Badge } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tones

```tsx
import { Badge } from "@semi/ui";

export default function BadgeTones() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Badge tone="emerald" dot>
        Hoàn thành
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="amber" dot>
        Đang xử lý
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="rose" dot>
        Thất bại
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="sky" icon="server">
        Đồng bộ
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="purple" icon="sparkles">
        Pro
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="gray" size="sm">
        Nháp
      </Badge>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Badge

Standard Bento Tag/Badge primitive with dual-theme tonal matching.
Uses 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + high-contrast text adapted for dark and light modes.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `SemanticTone` | `"gray"` | Chromatic tone matching the theme. Defaults to "gray". |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Optional leading icon from the Semi standard registry. |
| `dot` | `boolean` |  | Optional leading status dot in the tone's color. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `"md"` |  |

## Accessibility

- Text, not colour alone, carries the meaning; it never wraps.

<!-- docs/components/card.md -->

# Card

The bento content card: panel fill and the style's card border, radius and resting shadow. interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item.

## When to use

- Group the content of a page in cards; nested facts in TILE.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A metric | KpiCard |
| A tinted callout | Alert or TONAL_CONTAINER |

## Import

```tsx
import { Card, CARD, CARD_HOVER, CARD_ACTIVE, TILE } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Content card

```tsx
import { Badge, Card } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CardBasic() {
  return (
    <Card className="p-4 space-y-2 max-w-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="text-ui font-semibold text-contrast">X1 Carbon · Xưởng A</span>
        <Badge tone="emerald" dot>
          Online
        </Badge>
      </div>
      <p className="text-label text-muted">Đang in: vỏ hộp điều khiển · còn 42 phút</p>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

### Interactive and active

```tsx
import { Card, TILE } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CardStates() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 max-w-xl">
      <Card interactive className="p-4 space-y-2">
        <div className="text-ui font-semibold text-contrast">P1S · Xưởng B</div>
        <div className={`${TILE} p-2 text-label text-body tabular-nums`}>Đầu phun 220°C · Bàn 60°C</div>
      </Card>
      <Card interactive active className="p-4 space-y-2">
        <div className="text-ui font-semibold text-contrast">A1 Mini · đang in</div>
        <div className={`${TILE} p-2 text-label text-body tabular-nums`}>Tiến độ 64%</div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Card

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `false` | Clickable card (opens a detail view): hover border + press scale. |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | "On" / selected card: primary border, no glow. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A clickable card is a link or button inside the card, not a div with onClick.

## Notes

- Pass padding and layout only: no bg-* or shadow-* on <Card> (card-class-override).

<!-- docs/components/carousel.md -->

# Carousel

Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrow keys, buttons or dots (CSS scroll-snap, no library). Phones show one slide and a peek of the next.

## When to use

- Product photos, featured items, onboarding steps.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Content people must not miss | a grid or a list |
| Steps of a task | a form with sections |

## Import

```tsx
import { Carousel } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Products, 3 per view

```tsx
import { AspectRatio, Card, Carousel } from "@semi/ui";

const ITEMS = ["Giá đỡ điện thoại", "Hộp đựng tai nghe", "Móc khoá logo", "Chậu cây mini", "Kệ sách nhỏ"];

export default function CarouselProducts() {
  return (
    <Carousel label="Sản phẩm nổi bật" perView={3}>
      {ITEMS.map((name, i) => (
        <Card key={name} className="p-3 space-y-2">
          <AspectRatio ratio={4 / 3} className="rounded-control bg-field">
            <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-display font-semibold text-muted">{i + 1}</div>
          </AspectRatio>
          <div className="text-ui font-medium text-contrast">{name}</div>
          <div className="text-label text-muted tabular-nums">{(89 + i * 30).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}k ₫</div>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </Carousel>
  );
}
```

## API

### Carousel

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the carousel ("Ảnh sản phẩm"). |
| `perView` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 1` | `1` | Slides visible at once from sm up (phones always show one and a peek of the next). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | One child per slide. |

## Accessibility

- aria-roledescription="carousel" with a label; slides are labelled groups (“2 / 5”); the track is focusable and ←/→ move; no auto-play.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/carousel/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/chart.md -->

# Chart

Charts in SVG on Semi tokens, no library: BarChart (grouped or stacked columns), LineChart (optional area wash), DonutChart (parts of a whole) and Sparkline (a trend in a tile). Series use the fixed chart-1…8 colours (validated for colour-blind readers in both themes); every chart has a legend for 2+ series, a hover / keyboard tooltip and a table view.

## When to use

- Compare categories (BarChart), show change over time (LineChart), parts of a whole with ≤ 5 parts (DonutChart), a trend next to a KPI (Sparkline).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| One headline number | KpiCard (optionally with a Sparkline) |
| Exact values to compare and sort | DataTable |
| Two measures with different units | two charts, never a second y axis |
| More than 8 series | fold into “Khác”, or small multiples |

## Import

```tsx
import { BarChart, LineChart, DonutChart, Sparkline, type ChartSeries, type DonutSlice } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Grouped columns

```tsx
import { BarChart } from "@semi/ui";

const DATA = [
  { month: "T6", pla: 120, petg: 80 },
  { month: "T7", pla: 150, petg: 96 },
  { month: "T8", pla: 132, petg: 118 },
  { month: "T9", pla: 178, petg: 104 },
  { month: "T10", pla: 196, petg: 140 },
];

export default function ChartBar() {
  return (
    <BarChart
      label="Bản in theo vật liệu, 5 tháng"
      data={DATA}
      index="month"
      series={[
        { key: "pla", label: "PLA" },
        { key: "petg", label: "PETG" },
      ]}
      format={(v) => `${v} bản`}
    />
  );
}
```

### Stacked columns

```tsx
import { BarChart } from "@semi/ui";

const DATA = [
  { day: "T2", web: 32, shop: 18, partner: 9 },
  { day: "T3", web: 41, shop: 22, partner: 12 },
  { day: "T4", web: 28, shop: 25, partner: 8 },
  { day: "T5", web: 47, shop: 19, partner: 14 },
  { day: "T6", web: 53, shop: 31, partner: 16 },
  { day: "T7", web: 61, shop: 44, partner: 20 },
  { day: "CN", web: 38, shop: 40, partner: 11 },
];

export default function ChartStacked() {
  return (
    <BarChart
      stacked
      label="Đơn hàng theo kênh, 7 ngày"
      data={DATA}
      index="day"
      series={[
        { key: "web", label: "Website" },
        { key: "shop", label: "Cửa hàng" },
        { key: "partner", label: "Đối tác" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Lines with an area wash

```tsx
import { LineChart } from "@semi/ui";

const DATA = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({
  week: `Tuần ${i + 1}`,
  revenue: Math.round(40 + i * 4 + 10 * Math.sin(i / 1.6)),
  cost: Math.round(28 + i * 2 + 6 * Math.cos(i / 2)),
}));

export default function ChartLine() {
  return (
    <LineChart
      area
      label="Doanh thu và chi phí, 12 tuần (triệu ₫)"
      data={DATA}
      index="week"
      formatIndex={(w) => w.replace("Tuần ", "T")}
      series={[
        { key: "revenue", label: "Doanh thu" },
        { key: "cost", label: "Chi phí" },
      ]}
      format={(v) => `${v} tr ₫`}
    />
  );
}
```

### Donut

```tsx
import { DonutChart } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ChartDonut() {
  return (
    <DonutChart
      label="Đơn theo trạng thái"
      centerLabel="Tổng đơn"
      data={[
        { label: "Đã giao", value: 812 },
        { label: "Đang in", value: 164 },
        { label: "Chờ thanh toán", value: 96 },
        { label: "Huỷ", value: 31 },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Sparkline in a KPI row

```tsx
import { KpiCard, Sparkline } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ChartSparkline() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <div className="relative">
        <KpiCard label="Doanh thu tuần" value="61,8 tr ₫" sub="+12% so với tuần trước" tone="good" icon="coin" iconTone="green" />
        <Sparkline label="Doanh thu 8 tuần" values={[42, 45, 44, 50, 48, 55, 58, 62]} className="absolute right-4 bottom-4" />
      </div>
      <div className="relative">
        <KpiCard label="Tỉ lệ lỗi" value="1,8%" sub="-0,4 điểm" tone="good" icon="alert" iconTone="pink" />
        <Sparkline label="Tỉ lệ lỗi 8 tuần" values={[3.1, 2.9, 3.4, 2.6, 2.4, 2.2, 2.0, 1.8]} className="absolute right-4 bottom-4" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### BarChart

Columns per category: grouped (default) or `stacked`. ≤24px columns with 4px rounded tops, a 2px gap between stacked
segments. Hover or ←/→ on the focused chart shows every series of a category; the table view lists all values.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` * | `Row[]` |  |  |
| `index` * | `string` |  | Field holding the category / date of each row (the x axis). |
| `series` * | `ChartSeries[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name; also the table view's caption. Put the visible title in your card heading. |
| `height` | `number` |  | Plot height in px (default 240). |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | How values read (tooltip, table, labels); axis ticks are compacted (1,2K). |
| `formatIndex` | `(value: string) => string` |  | How an index value reads ("2026-10" → "T10"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `stacked` | `boolean` |  |  |

### LineChart

Lines over an index (usually time), 2px with an end dot; `area` adds a 10% wash under each line. A crosshair snaps
to the nearest index on hover or ←/→ and lists every series.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` * | `Row[]` |  |  |
| `index` * | `string` |  | Field holding the category / date of each row (the x axis). |
| `series` * | `ChartSeries[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name; also the table view's caption. Put the visible title in your card heading. |
| `height` | `number` |  | Plot height in px (default 240). |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | How values read (tooltip, table, labels); axis ticks are compacted (1,2K). |
| `formatIndex` | `(value: string) => string` |  | How an index value reads ("2026-10" → "T10"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `area` | `boolean` |  |  |

### DonutChart

Parts of a whole (≤ 5 slices; fold the rest into "Khác"). Slices are separated by a 2px surface gap; the centre shows
the total (or `centerLabel`); the legend lists every slice with its value and share.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` * | `DonutSlice[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(v) => v.toLocaleString("vi-VN")` |  |
| `centerLabel` | `string` |  | Text under the centre figure ("Tổng đơn"). |
| `size` | `number` | `180` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### Sparkline

A small trend line for a KPI tile or a table cell: muted line, the last point in the accent. Decorative detail:
the label states the trend for screen readers (first, last, min, max).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` * | `number[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `width` | `number` | `96` |  |
| `height` | `number` | `28` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Each chart is role="img" with a label; focus it and use ←/→ (Home / End) to read every index in the tooltip; “Xem bảng” switches to a table with all values.
- Colour is never the only channel: legend (2+ series), tooltip labels and the table view carry identity; text stays in text tokens.

## Notes

- Keep a series' colour fixed per entity (color: slot) so a filter never repaints the others.
- Put the visible title in the card around the chart; label is the accessible name.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/chart/ and the types in src/ -->

# Code block

Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button and an optional title (file name); long lines scroll sideways. Plain text, no highlighting.

## When to use

- API keys and commands to copy, config snippets, developer docs.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A short value inline | <code> in text, or Kbd for keys |

## Import

```tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### With a file name

```tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CodeBlockBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <CodeBlock code="npx semi-brand preview" />
      <CodeBlock
        title="app/globals.css"
        code={`@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@semi/ui/tokens.css";
@import "@semi/ui/base.css";`}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### CodeBlock

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` * | `string` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The block is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it; the copy button is labelled and says when it copied.

# Collapsible

One section that opens and closes under its trigger row (advanced options, details of a log line).

## When to use

- Hide rarely used options (“Tuỳ chọn khác”), long details.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Several sections, one open at a time | Accordion |

## Import

```tsx
import { Collapsible } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Advanced options

```tsx
import { Collapsible, Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CollapsibleBasic() {
  return (
    <Collapsible title="Tuỳ chọn khác" className="max-w-md">
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Field label="Nhiệt độ bàn">
          <Input defaultValue="60 °C" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Tốc độ quạt">
          <Input defaultValue="40%" />
        </Field>
      </div>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}
```

## API

### Collapsible

One section that opens and closes under its trigger row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The trigger row (text, optionally with an icon or a count). |
| `open` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a button with aria-expanded / aria-controls; hidden content is out of the tab order.

<!-- docs/components/data-table.md -->

# Data table

A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it).

## When to use

- Admin lists: orders, customers, inventory, logs — sort by a column, search, act on several rows.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A static table with no interaction | Table |
| Entities with images and states | a grid of Card |
| Server-side paging and sorting | control sort / page, pass the current page's rows |

## Import

```tsx
import { DataTable, type DataTableColumn, type DataTableSort } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Orders: search, sort, select, page

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge, Button, DataTable, SearchInput, toast, type DataTableColumn } from "@semi/ui";

type Order = { id: string; customer: string; status: "paid" | "pending" | "refunded"; total: number; date: string };
const STATUS = { paid: ["emerald", "Đã thanh toán"], pending: ["amber", "Chờ xử lý"], refunded: ["rose", "Hoàn tiền"] } as const;
const ORDERS: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `SO-${1040 + i}`,
  customer: ["Nguyễn An", "Trần Bình", "Lê Chi", "Phạm Dũng", "Hoàng Hà"][i % 5],
  status: (["paid", "pending", "refunded"] as const)[i % 3],
  total: 180_000 + ((i * 97_000) % 2_400_000),
  date: `2026-10-${String(1 + (i % 28)).padStart(2, "0")}`,
}));

const COLUMNS: DataTableColumn<Order>[] = [
  { key: "id", header: "Mã đơn", sortable: true, cell: (o) => <span className="font-medium text-contrast">{o.id}</span> },
  { key: "customer", header: "Khách hàng", sortable: true },
  { key: "status", header: "Trạng thái", value: (o) => STATUS[o.status][1], cell: (o) => <Badge tone={STATUS[o.status][0]} dot>{STATUS[o.status][1]}</Badge> },
  { key: "date", header: "Ngày", sortable: true },
  { key: "total", header: "Tổng", sortable: true, numeric: true, cell: (o) => `${o.total.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫` },
];

export default function DataTableOrders() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <SearchInput value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="Tìm mã đơn, khách hàng…" className="w-64" />
      <DataTable
        label="Đơn hàng"
        rows={ORDERS}
        columns={COLUMNS}
        getRowId={(o) => o.id}
        search={q}
        defaultSort={{ key: "date", dir: "desc" }}
        selectable
        bulkActions={(ids) => (
          <Button size="sm" variant="danger" icon="trash" onClick={() => toast({ title: `Đã huỷ ${ids.length} đơn`, tone: "danger" })}>
            Huỷ đơn
          </Button>
        )}
        pageSize={8}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Loading and empty

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, DataTable } from "@semi/ui";

export default function DataTableStates() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setLoading((v) => !v)}>
        {loading ? "Xem trạng thái rỗng" : "Xem đang tải"}
      </Button>
      <DataTable
        label="Máy in"
        rows={[] as { id: string; name: string }[]}
        columns={[{ key: "name", header: "Tên máy" }]}
        getRowId={(r) => r.id}
        loading={loading}
        pageSize={4}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### DataTable

Sort by a column header (click again to reverse; aria-sort on the header), filter with `search` (every searchable
column, case and Vietnamese marks ignored), select rows with a checkbox column (select-all on the page, bulk
actions bar), page with Pagination. Shows skeleton rows while `loading` and an EmptyState when nothing is left.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` * | `T[]` |  |  |
| `columns` * | `DataTableColumn<T>[]` |  |  |
| `getRowId` * | `(row: T) => string` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the table (a visually hidden caption). |
| `search` | `string` | `""` | Filter text, usually from the toolbar's SearchInput. |
| `sort` | `null \| DataTableSort` |  |  |
| `defaultSort` | `DataTableSort` |  |  |
| `onSortChange` | `(sort: DataTableSort \| null) => void` |  |  |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Add a checkbox column. |
| `selected` | `string[]` |  |  |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(ids: string[]) => void` |  |  |
| `bulkActions` | `(ids: string[]) => ReactNode` |  | Shown above the table while rows are selected: buttons that act on the selection. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `0` | Rows per page; 0 shows all rows. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `empty` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown when there are no rows (or none match the search). |
| `onRowClick` | `(row: T) => void` |  | Make rows clickable (open the record). Keep a link or button in the row for keyboard users. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort on the header cell; the caption names the table; row checkboxes and select-all are labelled; aria-busy while loading.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/data-table/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/icon.md -->

# Icon

The semantic icon registry (stroke 1.75, 24px grid). IconTile is the rounded tinted square that leads cards and dialogs.

## When to use

- Every icon in the UI: pick the semantic name (trash = delete, close = dismiss, refresh = reload). See docs/ICONS.md.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A missing icon | add it to ICONS in @semi/ui (/semi-propose), never an inline <svg> |

## Import

```tsx
import { Icon, IconTile, ICONS, suggestIcon } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Icons and tiles

```tsx
import { Icon, IconTile } from "@semi/ui";

export default function IconBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      <Icon name="printer" className="w-5 h-5 text-body" />
      <Icon name="trash" className="w-5 h-5 text-danger-fg" title="Xoá" />
      <Icon name="refresh" className="w-5 h-5 text-accent-fg" />
      <IconTile name="box" tone="green" />
      <IconTile name="camera" tone="sky" size="lg" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Icon

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `"w-4 h-4"` |  |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | `1.75` |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |

### IconTile

Rounded square with an icon: the leading visual of cards, list rows and dialogs.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |  |
| `tone` | `'violet' \| 'sky' \| 'green' \| 'amber' \| 'pink' \| 'gray'` | `"green"` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `"md"` |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass title when the icon alone carries meaning.

<!-- docs/components/item.md -->

# Item

A list row — leading icon / avatar / image, title and description, meta on the right, actions — and ItemGroup, which stacks rows in a card with dividers.

## When to use

- Settings lists, files, members, notifications, linked records.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Rows compared column by column | Table or DataTable |
| Entities with images and status in a grid | Card |

## Import

```tsx
import { Item, ItemGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Settings list

```tsx
import { Badge, IconTile, Item, ItemGroup, Switch } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ItemSettings() {
  return (
    <ItemGroup label="Cài đặt máy in" showLabel className="max-w-lg">
      <Item media={<IconTile name="printer" tone="green" size="sm" />} title="X1 Carbon 03" description="Xưởng A · Online" meta={<Badge tone="emerald" dot size="sm">Online</Badge>} href="#printer" />
      <Item icon="bell" title="Thông báo" description="Khi in xong hoặc gặp lỗi" actions={<Switch checked onChange={() => undefined} label={<span className="sr-only">Thông báo</span>} />} />
      <Item icon="fileText" title="Nhật ký in" description="Lưu 30 ngày" meta="2,4 GB" />
    </ItemGroup>
  );
}
```

## API

### Item

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | A leading icon (or pass `media` for an Avatar, IconTile or image). |
| `media` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Right-aligned detail: a value, a Badge, a time. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Buttons or a Menu at the end (stay clickable on a linked row). |
| `href` | `string` |  | Make the whole row a link (next/link). |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  | Make the whole row a button. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### ItemGroup

Rows in a card with dividers; `label` names the list for screen readers (and shows above it when visible).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A linked row is one link (the whole row is clickable through a stretched link); actions stay separate buttons; ItemGroup is a labelled section.

# Kbd

A key or a shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) as key caps, for menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text.

## When to use

- Show the shortcut of an action next to it.

## Import

```tsx
import { Kbd } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Keys and shortcuts

```tsx
import { Kbd } from "@semi/ui";

export default function KbdBasic() {
  return (
    <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-ui text-body">
      Mở bảng lệnh <Kbd keys={["⌘", "K"]} /> · Gửi <Kbd keys={["Ctrl", "Enter"]} /> · Đóng <Kbd>Esc</Kbd>
    </p>
  );
}
```

## API

### Kbd

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keys` | `string[]` |  | Several keys of one shortcut: ["⌘", "K"] renders two key caps. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One key when `keys` is not given. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Rendered as <kbd>; screen readers read the key names.

# KPI card

A metric card: label, a large tabular figure, a sub line coloured good / danger, and an icon in its tone.

## When to use

- The metric row at the top of a dashboard (2–4 per row).

## Import

```tsx
import { KpiCard } from "@semi/ui";
```

### Dashboard row

```tsx
import { KpiCard } from "@semi/ui";

export default function KpiCardRow() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 grid-cols-2 @3xl:grid-cols-4">
      <KpiCard label="Sản lượng in" value="1.842" sub="+12.4% so với tuần trước" tone="good" icon="box" iconTone="green" />
      <KpiCard label="Doanh thu" value="48,2 tr ₫" sub="+8.6% so với tháng trước" tone="good" icon="coin" iconTone="pink" />
      <KpiCard label="Giờ máy chạy" value="5.420 h" sub="-2.1%" tone="danger" icon="clock" iconTone="sky" />
      <KpiCard label="Tỉ lệ thành công" value="98.7%" icon="check" iconTone="violet" loading={false} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### KpiCard

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `sub` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'good'` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Bật \`Z-hop\` khi di chuyển
- Lớp đầu tiên: 0.24 mm

Xem thêm tại https://example.com/petg-guide`;

export default function MarkdownBasic() {

<!-- docs/components/separator.md -->

# Separator

A thin divider between groups of content: horizontal, vertical, or with a short label in the middle (“hoặc”).

## When to use

- Split groups inside a card or menu; “hoặc” between two ways to sign in.
- A vertical rule between toolbar groups.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Space between sections | a gap (space-y-*) — most layouts need no line |

## Import

```tsx
import { Separator } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Horizontal, label and vertical

```tsx
import { Button, Separator } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SeparatorBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 max-w-sm">
      <p className="text-ui text-body">Thông tin máy in</p>
      <Separator />
      <Button variant="primary" fullWidth>
        Đăng nhập bằng email
      </Button>
      <Separator label="hoặc" />
      <Button fullWidth>Đăng nhập bằng Google</Button>
      <div className="flex h-6 items-center gap-3 text-label text-muted">
        <span>Máy in</span>
        <Separator orientation="vertical" />
        <span>Vật liệu</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Separator

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `"horizontal"` |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Short text in the middle of a horizontal line ("hoặc"). |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `true` | true (default): purely visual, hidden from screen readers. false: announced as a separator. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Decorative by default (hidden from screen readers); decorative={false} announces a separator.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/separator/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/table.md -->

# Table

A dense table for rows compared column by column. Cells stay on one line (the table scrolls sideways on phones); TD wrap for a long-text column, numeric for figures.

## When to use

- Orders, invoices, logs: rows compared by column.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Entities with images or many states | a grid of Card |

## Import

```tsx
import { Table, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Orders

```tsx
import { Avatar, Badge, Table, TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR } from "@semi/ui";

const ORDERS = [
  { id: "SO-1042", customer: "Nguyễn An", status: ["emerald", "Đã thanh toán"], total: 1_250_000 },
  { id: "SO-1043", customer: "Trần Bình", status: ["amber", "Chờ xử lý"], total: 480_000 },
  { id: "SO-1044", customer: "Lê Chi", status: ["rose", "Hoàn tiền"], total: 2_100_000 },
] as const;

export default function TableOrders() {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-card border border-line overflow-hidden">
      <Table>
        <THead>
          <TR>
            <TH>Mã đơn</TH>
            <TH>Khách hàng</TH>
            <TH>Trạng thái</TH>
            <TH align="right">Tổng</TH>
          </TR>
        </THead>
        <TBody>
          {ORDERS.map((o) => (
            <TR key={o.id}>
              <TD className="font-medium text-contrast">{o.id}</TD>
              <TD>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Avatar name={o.customer} size="sm" />
                  {o.customer}
                </span>
              </TD>
              <TD>
                <Badge tone={o.status[0]} dot>
                  {o.status[1]}
                </Badge>
              </TD>
              <TD numeric>{o.total.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫</TD>
            </TR>
          ))}
        </TBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Table

No props of its own.

### THead

No props of its own.

### TBody

No props of its own.

### TR

A clickable row (onClick) gets the hover fill and a pointer; give it a link or button inside for keyboard users.

No props of its own.

### TH

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'center'` | `"left"` |  |

### TD

`numeric` right-aligns and sets tabular-nums (money, counts, dates); `wrap` lets long text wrap (min 12rem wide).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'center'` |  |  |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

## Accessibility

- Real <table> semantics; a clickable TR is reachable by keyboard (Enter).

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/table/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/typography.md -->

# Typography

The type scale (text-caption 11 … text-display 26, font-display for titles) and Prose, which styles long-form text — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code — from that scale.

## When to use

- Help articles, release notes, policies, long AI answers (wrap Markdown in Prose).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Page title | PageTitle |
| UI text in cards and forms | the type classes directly (text-ui, text-label…) |

## Import

```tsx
import { Prose } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Type scale

```tsx
export default function TypographyScale() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <div className="font-display text-display text-contrast">Hiển thị 26</div>
      <div className="text-heading text-contrast font-semibold">Tiêu đề trang 22</div>
      <div className="text-title-lg text-contrast font-semibold">Tiêu đề 16</div>
      <div className="text-title text-contrast font-medium">Tiêu đề thẻ 15</div>
      <div className="text-ui-lg text-body">Nội dung dài 14</div>
      <div className="text-ui text-body">Giao diện 13</div>
      <div className="text-label text-muted">Nhãn 12</div>
      <div className="text-caption text-muted">Chú thích 11</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Prose

```tsx
import { Prose } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TypographyProse() {
  return (
    <Prose>
      <h2>Bảo quản vật liệu</h2>
      <p>
        Nhựa PETG và TPU <strong>hút ẩm nhanh</strong>. Giữ cuộn trong hộp kín có gói hút ẩm, hoặc sấy ở <code>65°C</code> trước khi in.
      </p>
      <ul>
        <li>PLA: để nơi khô ráo, tránh nắng</li>
        <li>PETG: sấy 4 giờ nếu mở hơn một tuần</li>
      </ul>
      <blockquote>Bản in bị rỗ bề mặt thường là do nhựa ẩm.</blockquote>
      <p>
        Xem thêm <a href="#guide">hướng dẫn sấy nhựa</a>.
      </p>
    </Prose>
  );
}
```

## API

### Prose

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Keep a real heading order (h2 → h3); Prose caps the line length (max-w-prose) for reading.

<!-- docs/components/alert.md -->

# Alert

A message that stays on the page: info, success, warning, danger, with a title, an action and an optional dismiss.

## When to use

- State the user must see while working (firmware update, low material, failed print).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A passing confirmation | toast() |
| Ask before acting | confirmDialog() |

## Import

```tsx
import { Alert } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tones

```tsx
import { Alert, Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AlertTones() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <Alert tone="info" title="Bản cập nhật mới">
        Firmware 1.08 đã sẵn sàng cho 3 máy.
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="success" title="Đã kết nối">
        Máy X1 Carbon đang online.
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="warning" title="Sắp hết nhựa" action={<Button size="sm">Đặt thêm</Button>}>
        Cuộn PLA đen còn khoảng 80 g.
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="danger" title="In thất bại">
        Đầu phun bị tắc ở lớp 132.
      </Alert>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Dismissible

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Alert, Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AlertDismiss() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  return open ? (
    <Alert tone="warning" title="Mất kết nối camera" onDismiss={() => setOpen(false)}>
      Ảnh sẽ cập nhật lại khi máy online.
    </Alert>
  ) : (
    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
      Hiện lại
    </Button>
  );
}
```

## API

### Alert

Callout inside a page or form (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §3b): tinted surface, tone icon, optional action / dismiss.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning'` | `"info"` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Override the tone's icon. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A button or link shown under the text. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="status" (role="alert" for danger); the dismiss button is labelled.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/alert/ and the types in src/ -->

# Empty state

What an empty list or page shows: an icon, one short title, a description and the action that fills it.

## When to use

- No items yet, no search results, a feature not set up.

## Import

```tsx
import { EmptyState } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### First item

```tsx
import { Button, EmptyState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function EmptyStateBasic() {
  return (
    <EmptyState
      icon="printer"
      title="Chưa có máy in nào"
      description="Thêm máy in đầu tiên để theo dõi tiến độ và nhiệt độ."
      action={
        <Button variant="primary" icon="plus">
          Thêm máy in
        </Button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### EmptyState

Empty list / first-run state: icon, one short line, optional description and action (EMPTY surface).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"box"` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The title is a heading; the action is a normal button.

# Progress

A determinate bar with value, or an indeterminate one when the end is unknown; tones for success and danger.

## When to use

- Print progress, upload, storage used.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Content still loading | Skeleton |

## Import

```tsx
import { Progress } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Values and tones

```tsx
import { Progress } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ProgressBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <Progress label="Tiến độ in" value={64} showValue />
      <Progress label="Dung lượng" value={92} tone="danger" showValue />
      <Progress label="Đang xử lý" />
      <Progress label="Đã tải" value={30} tone="success" size="sm" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Progress

Determinate or indeterminate progress bar (uploads, quotas, print progress).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` |  | Omit for an indeterminate bar. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'accent'` | `"accent"` |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Visible label above the bar (also its accessible name). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `"md"` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow / max; the label names it.

<!-- docs/components/skeleton.md -->

# Skeleton

Shimmer placeholders while content loads: Skeleton blocks, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton; Loading announces the region. Never “Đang tải…” text.

## When to use

- Any content that is loading: show its shape.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| An action in progress | Button loading or Spinner |
| A known amount of work | Progress |

## Import

```tsx
import { Skeleton, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton, Loading } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Card and rows

```tsx
import { SkeletonCard, SkeletonRows } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SkeletonCardRows() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <SkeletonCard />
      <SkeletonRows count={3} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Page and grid

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Loading, PageSkeleton, SkeletonGrid } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SkeletonPage() {
  const [shape, setShape] = useState<"grid" | "page">("grid");
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button size="sm" variant={shape === "grid" ? "primary" : "secondary"} onClick={() => setShape("grid")}>
          SkeletonGrid
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant={shape === "page" ? "primary" : "secondary"} onClick={() => setShape("page")}>
          PageSkeleton
        </Button>
      </div>
      {shape === "grid" ? (
        <SkeletonGrid count={3} className="grid grid-cols-1 @2xl:grid-cols-3 gap-3" />
      ) : (
        <Loading>
          <PageSkeleton />
        </Loading>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Skeleton

One shimmering block; size and radius come from className (default rounded-control).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` |  |  |

### SkeletonCard

Card placeholder: icon tile + two text lines, then an optional body block.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | `null \| string` | `"h-24"` |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

### SkeletonGrid

Grid of card placeholders (the grid classes should match the real grid).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | `number` | `6` |  |
| `className` | `string` | `"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-3"` |  |
| `body` | `null \| string` | `"h-24"` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

### SkeletonRows

List row placeholders (dialog lists, tables).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | `number` | `5` |  |
| `className` | `string` | `"flex flex-col gap-2"` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

### PageSkeleton

Whole-page placeholder (Suspense fallbacks): title row + a grid of cards.

No props of its own.

### Loading

Wrapper that tells assistive tech the region is loading. `relative` keeps the absolute sr-only label inside scroll containers.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Loading (and the Skeleton* groups with label) set role="status" + aria-busy so screen readers hear one message.

<!-- docs/components/action-confirmation.md -->

# Action confirmation

An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send, delete, pay, run a command): what it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; the outcome replaces the buttons once decided.

## When to use

- Human-in-the-loop: any agent action that is outward-facing, costs money or cannot be undone.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Confirming a person's own action | confirmDialog |

## Import

```tsx
import { ActionConfirmation } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Approve or reject

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ActionConfirmation } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ActionConfirmationApprove() {
  const [mail, setMail] = useState<"pending" | "approved" | "rejected">("pending");
  const [wipe, setWipe] = useState<"pending" | "approved" | "rejected">("pending");
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 max-w-xl">
      <ActionConfirmation title="Gửi email báo giá cho 3 khách hàng?" icon="send" approveLabel="Gửi 3 email" state={mail} onApprove={() => setMail("approved")} onReject={() => setMail("rejected")}>
        an@example.com, binh@example.com, chi@example.com
      </ActionConfirmation>
      <ActionConfirmation title="Xoá 128 tệp G-code cũ hơn 90 ngày?" icon="trash" danger approveLabel="Xoá 128 tệp" state={wipe} onApprove={() => setWipe("approved")} onReject={() => setWipe("rejected")}>
        Không thể khôi phục sau khi xoá.
      </ActionConfirmation>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ActionConfirmation

An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send an email, delete files, spend money). Shows what
it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; once decided, the outcome replaces the buttons so the log stays readable.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | What it will do, as a question or a short line (“Gửi email cho 3 khách hàng?”). |
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"shield"` |  |
| `state` | `'pending' \| 'approved' \| 'rejected'` | `"pending"` |  |
| `danger` | `boolean` | `false` | The action cannot be undone: the approve button is red. |
| `approveLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `rejectLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `onApprove` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `onReject` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The details (recipients, files, the command). |

## Accessibility

- A labelled group; buttons say what they do (approveLabel “Gửi 3 email”); danger makes the approve button red for actions that cannot be undone.

## Notes

- Keep it in the conversation after the decision (state) so the log shows who allowed what.
