<!-- docs/components/ai-chat.md -->

# AI chat

AIChat is the ready-made assistant panel: ChatPanel (side panel or full screen, resizable, keyboard inset) around ChatView (list + composer). UI only: the app keeps the messages, streams the answer and calls the model.

## When to use

- Every AI conversation in a Semi app (assistant beside a workspace, help over a modal).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A different layout of the same parts | ChatPanel + ChatView + the message parts (Chat messages doc) |

## Import

```tsx
import { AIChat, ChatPanel, ChatView, type ChatItem } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Assistant beside a workspace

Type and press Enter: a fake assistant streams an answer; Stop, retry and new chat work.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AIChat, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion, ChatSuggestions, type ChatItem } from "@semi/ui";

const ANSWER = `Với **PETG**, thử các bước sau:

1. Nhiệt độ đầu phun **240–250°C**, bàn nhiệt 80°C
2. Quạt làm mát 30–50% (cao hơn dễ tách lớp)
3. Bật \`Z-hop\` 0.4 mm để giảm kéo sợi
4. Retraction 0.8 mm ở 40 mm/s, tăng thêm 0.2 mm nếu vẫn còn sợi

Nếu vẫn kéo sợi, sấy cuộn nhựa 65°C trong 4 giờ: PETG hút ẩm nhanh.`;

export default function AIChatWorkspace() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatItem[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const stop = () => {
    if (timer.current) clearInterval(timer.current);
    setBusy(false);
    setMessages((ms) => ms.map((m) => (m.pending ? { ...m, pending: false } : m)));
  };
  useEffect(() => stop, []);
  const send = (text: string) => {
    const id = Date.now();
    setMessages((ms) => [...ms, { id: `u${id}`, role: "user", content: text }, { id, role: "assistant", content: "", pending: true }]);
    setBusy(true);
    let i = 0;
    timer.current = setInterval(() => {
      i = Math.min(ANSWER.length, i + 4);
      setMessages((ms) => ms.map((m) => (m.id === id ? { ...m, content: ANSWER.slice(0, i), pending: i < ANSWER.length } : m)));
      if (i >= ANSWER.length) stop();
    }, 30);
  };
  return (
    <div className="relative h-[480px] rounded-card bg-canvas border border-line overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-label text-muted">Canvas / workspace</div>
      <AIChat
        title="Trợ lý AI"
        placement="workspace"
        shown
        onClose={() => undefined}
        messages={messages}
        busy={busy}
        onSend={send}
        onStop={stop}
        onRetry={() => send("Thử lại")}
        onNewChat={() => setMessages([])}
        value={draft}
        onValueChange={setDraft}
        placeholder="Hỏi về cài đặt in…"
        widthKey={null}
        empty={
          <>
            <ChatIntro title="Hỏi gì về bản in?">Trợ lý biết máy in, vật liệu và cài đặt slicer của bạn.</ChatIntro>
            <ChatSuggestions label="Gợi ý">
              <ChatSuggestion icon="sparkles" onClick={() => send("Vì sao PETG bị kéo sợi?")}>
                Vì sao PETG bị kéo sợi?
              </ChatSuggestion>
            </ChatSuggestions>
          </>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Over a modal

placement="screen" opens the assistant as a dialog over everything; Escape closes only the chat.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { AIChat, Button, Modal, type ChatItem } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AIChatOverModal() {
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(false);
  const [chat, setChat] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatItem[]>([]);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="layers" onClick={() => setModal(true)}>
        Mở lỗi máy in
      </Button>
      <Modal open={modal} onClose={() => setModal(false)} title="Lỗi máy in: HMS 0300-0100" description="Mở trợ lý AI ngay trên modal">
        <p className="text-ui text-body">placement=&quot;screen&quot; phủ cả trang: Esc chỉ đóng trợ lý, modal bên dưới vẫn giữ.</p>
        <Button variant="primary" icon="sparkles" onClick={() => setChat(true)}>
          Hỏi AI về lỗi này
        </Button>
      </Modal>
      {chat && (
        <AIChat
          title="Trợ lý AI"
          placement="screen"
          shown={chat}
          onClose={() => setChat(false)}
          messages={messages}
          busy={false}
          onSend={(text) => setMessages((ms) => [...ms, { id: Date.now(), role: "user", content: text }])}
          onStop={() => undefined}
          onRetry={() => undefined}
          onNewChat={() => setMessages([])}
          widthKey={null}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

## API

### AIChat

ChatPanel + ChatView + ChatComposer with the messages drawn the standard way. The app owns `messages` and `busy`;
the composer text is kept here unless `value` / `onValueChange` are passed (to fill it from a suggestion).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `string` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |  |
| `placement` | `'workspace' \| 'screen'` |  |  |
| `shown` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `setup` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `messages` * | `M[]` |  |  |
| `busy` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onSend` * | `(text: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onStop` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `onRetry` | `(m: M) => void` |  | Retry for a failed answer (gets that message). |
| `onNewChat` | `() => void` |  | Clears the conversation; the button shows once there is a message. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `empty` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown while there is no message (ChatIntro, ChatSuggestions). |
| `listEnd` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Under the last message (follow-up choices, a note). |
| `toolbar` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Under the field (model picker, attachments). |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `renderUser` | `(m: M) => ReactNode` |  |  |
| `renderAnswer` | `(m: M) => ReactNode` |  |  |
| `composer` | `boolean` | `true` | false hides the composer (read-only conversation). |
| `value` | `string` |  |  |
| `onValueChange` | `(text: string) => void` |  |  |
| `widthKey` | `null \| string` |  |  |

### ChatPanel

The side panel an AI conversation opens in. `placement="workspace"`: inside the nearest positioned parent, beside
the content (a tool's canvas, the page). `"screen"`: over the whole page as a dialog, also above an open Modal.
Phones always get the full screen. Resizable from `sm` (remembered per `widthKey`); Escape and × close it.
Keep it mounted with `shown={false}` while it slides out, then unmount.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `string` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` |  |
| `placement` | `'workspace' \| 'screen'` | `"workspace"` |  |
| `shown` | `boolean` | `true` | false while the panel animates out. |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `onNewChat` | `() => void` |  | Shows the "new chat" button (pass it only once there is a conversation). |
| `newChatDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Extra header buttons, before "new chat" and close. |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `defaultWidth` | `number` | `CHAT_PANEL_WIDTH` |  |
| `widthKey` | `null \| string` | `"semi-chat-panel-width"` | localStorage key of the width; null = do not remember. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Usually a ChatView. |

### ChatView

Loading skeleton, `setup` (e.g. "AI is not set up" + a settings button) in place of the chat, or the list above the composer.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `setup` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `announcement` | `string` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `empty` | `boolean` |  | Only the intro is showing (see ChatList). |
| `composer` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The list announces one message per finished answer; Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, IME composition is safe; placement="screen" is a dialog where Escape closes only the chat.

## Notes

- The model picker goes in toolbar (ChatModelPicker); provider and model lists are app data.

<!-- docs/components/chat-messages.md -->

# Chat messages

The parts of a conversation, to compose your own chat: UserMessage, AssistantMessage (+ ChatAnswer for a ChatItem), ChatThinking, ChatError, ChatCopyButton, ChatAvatar, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion(s), ChatList and ChatComposer.

## When to use

- A chat that does not fit AIChat's layout; AI output inside another feature.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A standard assistant panel | AIChat |

## Import

```tsx
import { UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ChatAnswer, ChatAvatar, ChatCopyButton, ChatError, ChatThinking, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion, ChatSuggestions, ChatList, ChatComposer, CHAT_CHIP, CHAT_ROW } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Messages

```tsx
import { AssistantMessage, ChatCopyButton, ChatError, ChatThinking, Markdown, UserMessage } from "@semi/ui";

const ANSWER = "Giảm quạt xuống **30%** và bật `Z-hop` khi di chuyển.";

export default function ChatMessagesParts() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 max-w-xl">
      <UserMessage>Vì sao bản in PETG bị kéo sợi?</UserMessage>
      <AssistantMessage actions={<ChatCopyButton text={ANSWER} />}>
        <Markdown text={ANSWER} />
      </AssistantMessage>
      <AssistantMessage busy>
        <ChatThinking label="Đang đọc cài đặt máy in" />
      </AssistantMessage>
      <ChatError onRetry={() => undefined}>Không kết nối được tới model.</ChatError>
      <ChatError tone="warning">Câu trả lời bị cắt vì quá dài.</ChatError>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Your own chat from parts

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ChatComposer, ChatIntro, ChatList, UserMessage } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ChatMessagesCompose() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="flex h-80 max-w-xl flex-col rounded-card border border-line bg-panel">
      <ChatList label="Ghi chú" empty={items.length === 0}>
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <ChatIntro title="Ghi chú cho đơn in">Viết gì đó rồi Enter.</ChatIntro>
        ) : (
          items.map((t, i) => <UserMessage key={i}>{t}</UserMessage>)
        )}
      </ChatList>
      <div className="p-2">
        <ChatComposer
          value={text}
          onChange={setText}
          onSend={(t) => {
            setItems((v) => [...v, t]);
            setText("");
          }}
          placeholder="Viết ghi chú…"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### UserMessage

The user's message, right-aligned. `failed`: its answer failed (shown dimmed, not sent again).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `failed` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### AssistantMessage

An AI answer, left-aligned behind the avatar. `actions` (copy, feedback) show under it once it is done.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### ChatAnswer

An answer as most chats show it: the error (with retry), the Markdown text with copy, or "thinking" while empty.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `msg` * | `ChatItem` |  |  |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `copyable` | `boolean` | `true` |  |

### ChatAvatar

Small sparkles tile in front of every AI answer (pulses while it streams).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` |  |

### ChatCopyButton

Copies `text` (an answer, a code block); shows a check for a moment.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` * | `string` |  |  |

### ChatError

A failed answer (or an AI note in a warning tone), with an optional retry.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'warning'` | `"danger"` |  |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### ChatThinking

"Đang suy nghĩ" (or what the AI is doing) with three bouncing dots, while no text has come yet.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

### ChatIntro

Icon, title and one line above an empty conversation.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` |  |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### ChatSuggestion

One suggested request (a button), or with `href` a link to another site (opens outside the app).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `href` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### ChatSuggestions

A column of ChatSuggestion rows, with an optional small heading.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### ChatList

The scrolling message list (role="log"). Follows new text only while the reader is at the bottom: scrolled up to
read, it stays put and offers "jump to latest". Streamed tokens are not read out one by one; when `busy` ends the
finished answer (`announcement`, else "answer complete") is announced once. `empty` (only the intro / suggestions
showing) keeps it at the top so the intro is read from its start.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `announcement` | `string` |  |  |
| `empty` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the log (the panel title). |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### ChatComposer

The question field with send / stop, and an optional `toolbar` under it (model picker, attachments). Controlled:
the caller keeps the text (so it can fill it, e.g. from a suggestion). Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, and
Enter while an input method is composing (Vietnamese Telex / VNI, CJK) only confirms the word. Focus returns to the
field once the answer to a typed question is done (not after one the app started itself: that would pop up the
keyboard on a tablet).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(text: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onSend` * | `(text: string) => void` |  | Gets the trimmed text; the field is not cleared here. |
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `onStop` | `() => void` |  | Shown as a Stop button while `busy`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `maxLength` | `number` | `4000` |  |
| `rows` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `inputRef` | `RefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement \| null>` |  |  |
| `toolbar` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- ChatList keeps scroll position while the user reads up and offers “jump to latest”; ChatComposer is a labelled textarea with send / stop buttons.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/chat-messages/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/chat-model-picker.md -->

# Chat model picker

Provider → model → effort chips, for the toolbar of a chat composer. The lists are app data.

## When to use

- Let people pick the provider, model and thinking effort of an AI feature.

## Import

```tsx
import { ChatModelPicker, CHAT_PICK_CHIP } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Provider, model, effort

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ChatModelPicker, Icon } from "@semi/ui";

const PROVIDERS = [
  { id: "claude", name: "Claude", models: [{ id: "opus", label: "Opus 5.5", efforts: true }, { id: "haiku", label: "Haiku 5.5" }] },
  { id: "local", name: "Ollama (máy này)", models: [{ id: "llama", label: "llama-local" }] },
];

export default function ChatModelPickerBasic() {
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState("claude");
  const [model, setModel] = useState("opus");
  const [effort, setEffort] = useState("");
  const current = PROVIDERS.find((p) => p.id === provider)!;
  const hasEffort = current.models.find((m) => m.id === model && "efforts" in m);
  return (
    <ChatModelPicker
      providers={PROVIDERS.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: p.name, icon: <Icon name="sparkles" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> }))}
      provider={provider}
      onProviderChange={(v) => {
        setProvider(v);
        setModel(PROVIDERS.find((p) => p.id === v)!.models[0].id);
      }}
      models={current.models.map((m) => ({ value: m.id, label: m.label }))}
      model={model}
      onModelChange={setModel}
      efforts={hasEffort ? [{ value: "", label: "Tự động" }, { value: "high", label: "Nghĩ kỹ" }] : []}
      effort={effort}
      onEffortChange={setEffort}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### ChatModelPicker

Provider, model and thinking-effort chips, like the model picker of the Claude / Gemini apps; pass it as the
composer `toolbar`. UI only: the app lists what is ready and remembers the pick. The provider chip shows only when
more than one provider is offered, as its logo (`icon`; the name is the tooltip and the label in the list); the
effort chip only when the model takes one. The chips stay usable while an answer streams (the pick applies to the
next question).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `providers` | `CustomSelectOption[]` | `[]` | Ready providers / profiles (Claude, OpenAI, a local server…): `icon` = its logo in the text colour. |
| `provider` | `string` |  |  |
| `onProviderChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `models` * | `CustomSelectOption[]` |  | The current provider's models (`title` e.g. "default of this provider"). |
| `model` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onModelChange` * | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `efforts` | `CustomSelectOption[]` | `[]` | Thinking levels the current model takes (empty = no effort chip). |
| `effort` | `string` |  |  |
| `onEffortChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

## Accessibility

- Each chip is a select button with its own label; changing the provider resets the model.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/chat-model-picker/ and the types in src/ -->

# Context meter

How full the model's context window is: a small ring with the percent, token counts in a tooltip; amber from 80%, red from 95%.

## When to use

- Next to the composer or model picker in long chats and agent sessions.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A quota or upload progress | Progress |

## Import

```tsx
import { ContextMeter } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Levels

```tsx
import { ContextMeter } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ContextMeterLevels() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      <ContextMeter used={12_400} total={200_000} />
      <ContextMeter used={168_000} total={200_000} />
      <ContextMeter used={196_500} total={200_000} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ContextMeter

How much of the model's context window is used: a small ring and the percent (role="meter"), with the token counts
in a tooltip. Turns amber from 80% and red from 95%, when the app should summarise or start a new chat.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `used` * | `number` |  |  |
| `total` * | `number` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="meter" with aria-valuetext “12K / 200K token (6%)”; focusable so keyboard users get the tooltip; colour is backed by the percent.

<!-- docs/components/file-tree.md -->

# File tree

Files and folders as a keyboard tree, with A / M / D marks for what an agent added, modified or deleted; select a file to open it.

## When to use

- Changes an agent made, a repo or export browser, attachments with folders.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A flat list of files | Item in an ItemGroup |

## Import

```tsx
import { FileTree, type FileNode } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Changed files

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FileTree, type FileNode } from "@semi/ui";

const FILES: FileNode[] = [
  {
    name: "src",
    children: [
      { name: "components", children: [{ name: "PrinterCard.tsx", change: "modified" }, { name: "QueueList.tsx", change: "added" }, { name: "OldQueue.tsx", change: "deleted" }] },
      { name: "app.tsx" },
    ],
  },
  { name: "package.json", change: "modified" },
  { name: "README.md" },
];

export default function FileTreeChanges() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState("src/components/PrinterCard.tsx");
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 @xl:grid-cols-[240px_1fr]">
      <FileTree label="Tệp đã thay đổi" files={FILES} selected={file} onSelect={setFile} className="rounded-card border border-line bg-panel p-1.5" />
      <div className="rounded-card border border-line p-3 text-label text-muted break-all">{file}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### FileTree

Files and folders (a repo, a diff, an export): a keyboard tree (role="tree"). ↑/↓ move, → opens a folder or enters
it, ← closes it or goes to the parent, Home / End, Enter selects a file (or toggles a folder). Paths are the names
joined by "/".

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` * | `FileNode[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tree. |
| `selected` | `string` |  | Path of the selected file. |
| `onSelect` | `(path: string, node: FileNode) => void` |  |  |
| `defaultExpanded` | `string[]` |  | Folder paths open at first (default: every folder). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="tree" with treeitems (aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected); ↑/↓, →/← open and close, Home / End, Enter selects; change marks have text for screen readers.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/file-tree/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/reasoning.md -->

# Reasoning

The model's reasoning above its answer: open while it streams, folded to “Đã suy luận trong N giây” when done, reopenable.

## When to use

- Models that expose thinking / reasoning text; show it before the AssistantMessage body.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A wait with no text yet | ChatThinking |

## Import

```tsx
import { Reasoning } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Streaming, then folded

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AssistantMessage, Button, Reasoning } from "@semi/ui";

const STEPS = ["Người dùng hỏi về nhiệt độ in PETG.", "Nhà sản xuất khuyên 230–250°C cho đầu phun 0,4 mm.", "Bàn nhiệt 70–80°C để bám tốt mà không bị dính chặt.", "Nên giảm quạt làm mát để lớp dính nhau hơn."];

export default function ReasoningStreaming() {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(STEPS.length);
  const busy = shown < STEPS.length;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!busy) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => setShown((n) => n + 1), 700);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [busy, shown]);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 max-w-xl">
      <Reasoning busy={busy} duration={4}>
        {STEPS.slice(0, shown).join("\n")}
      </Reasoning>
      {!busy && <AssistantMessage>In PETG ở 240°C, bàn nhiệt 75°C và quạt khoảng 30–50%.</AssistantMessage>}
      <div>
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" icon="refresh" onClick={() => setShown(0)}>
          Chạy lại
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Reasoning

The model's reasoning above its answer. Open while `busy` (the text streams in), folded to “Đã suy luận trong 12
giây” once it is done; people can open it again. A toggle by the user wins over the automatic open / close.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` | The model is still reasoning. |
| `duration` | `number` |  | Seconds it took, shown once done. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  | Start open (default: open only while busy). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A disclosure button (aria-expanded); the reasoning text is not a live region, so screen readers hear the answer, not every reasoning token.

## Notes

- Pass busy while reasoning streams; once a person toggles it, Reasoning stops opening and closing by itself.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/reasoning/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/sources.md -->

# Sources

Where an answer came from: Citation marks inside the text (numbered, linked) and a Sources list under the answer that opens to the pages.

## When to use

- Answers built from search or documents (RAG); every claim that came from a page.

## Import

```tsx
import { Sources, Citation, type Source } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Answer with citations

```tsx
import { AssistantMessage, Citation, Sources, type Source } from "@semi/ui";

const SOURCES: Source[] = [
  { title: "Hướng dẫn in PETG", href: "https://example.com/petg-guide", description: "Nhiệt độ, quạt và bàn nhiệt" },
  { title: "Bảng thông số vật liệu", href: "https://docs.example.com/materials" },
  { title: "Diễn đàn: PETG bị kéo sợi", href: "https://forum.example.com/t/petg-stringing" },
];

export default function SourcesAnswer() {
  return (
    <div className="max-w-xl">
      <AssistantMessage actions={<Sources sources={SOURCES} />}>
        In PETG ở 230–250°C<Citation n={1} source={SOURCES[0]} />, bàn nhiệt 70–80°C<Citation n={2} source={SOURCES[1]} />. Kéo sợi thường giảm khi tăng rút
        nhựa lên 1–2 mm<Citation n={3} source={SOURCES[2]} />.
      </AssistantMessage>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Sources

“3 nguồn” under an answer, opening to the numbered list of pages it used (numbers match its `Citation`s).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sources` * | `Source[]` |  |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### Citation

A numbered citation inside answer text, linking to its source; hover or focus shows the title.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `n` * | `number` |  |  |
| `source` * | `Source` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Citations are links named “Nguồn 2: title”; the list is a disclosure with an ordered list of external links (new tab).

# Task list

The agent's plan: steps with a status mark (chưa làm, đang làm, xong, lỗi, bỏ qua), an optional line under each, and a progress count.

## When to use

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Steps of a form | sections of the form |
| One running bar | Progress |

```tsx
import { TaskList, type TaskStep, type TaskStatus } from "@semi/ui";
```

```tsx

export default function TaskListPlan() {
  return (
    <TaskList
      className="max-w-md"
      title="In 20 giá đỡ cho đơn #1042"
      steps={[
        { label: "Kiểm tra tệp mô hình", status: "done" },
        { label: "Chọn máy in còn trống", status: "done", detail: "X1 Carbon 03, PETG đen" },
        { label: "Cắt lớp và ước lượng thời gian", status: "running" },
        { label: "Đặt lịch in", status: "pending" },
        { label: "Gửi báo giá cho khách", status: "skipped", detail: "Khách đã thanh toán trước" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### TaskList

The agent's plan: steps with their status and a progress count. The running step is marked aria-current.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `steps` * | `TaskStep[]` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- An ordered list; each step's status is also text (visually hidden); the running step has aria-current="step".

<!-- docs/components/terminal.md -->

# Terminal

A command and its output: streams and follows the end (unless people scroll up), shows a spinner while running and the exit code when done, with a copy button.

## When to use

- Agents and jobs that run shell commands, builds, deploy logs.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A snippet to copy | CodeBlock |
| A tool call with JSON in / out | ToolCall |

## Import

```tsx
import { Terminal } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### A build that streams

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button, Terminal } from "@semi/ui";

const LINES = ["> semi-docs@0.12.0 build", "> next build", "", "  Next.js 16", "  Creating an optimized production build", "  Compiled successfully", "  Generating static pages (128/128)", "", "Done in 14.2s"];

export default function TerminalRun() {
  const [n, setN] = useState(LINES.length);
  const running = n < LINES.length;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => setN((x) => x + 1), 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [running, n]);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 max-w-xl">
      <Terminal command="npm run build" output={LINES.slice(0, n).join("\n")} status={running ? "running" : "done"} exitCode={0} maxHeight={220} />
      <Terminal command="npm test" output={"FAIL tests/queue.test.ts\n1 failed, 42 passed"} exitCode={1} />
      <div>
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" icon="play" onClick={() => setN(0)}>
          Chạy lại
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Terminal

Follows the end of the output while it streams, unless people scrolled up to read. The log is focusable (keyboard
scrolling) and not a live region: output read aloud line by line would drown everything else.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `string` |  | The command line, shown first after “$”. |
| `output` * | `string` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  | Name above the output (default: the command). |
| `status` | `'running' \| 'done'` | `"done"` |  |
| `exitCode` | `number` |  | Shown once done: 0 green, anything else red. |
| `maxHeight` | `number` | `320` | Height in px before the output scrolls. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The log is focusable for keyboard scrolling and not a live region (streamed lines are not read aloud); status is text (exit code).

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/terminal/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/tool-call.md -->

# Tool call

One tool the agent called: its name in words, a status badge (chờ, đang chạy, xong, lỗi, chờ duyệt), and on open the input and output (JSON formatted).

## When to use

- Agent runs and chats where the model calls functions, MCP tools or APIs.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A shell command and its output | Terminal |
| A list of planned steps | TaskList |

## Import

```tsx
import { ToolCall, type ToolCallStatus } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Every state

```tsx
import { ToolCall } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ToolCallStates() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-xl">
      <ToolCall
        name="search_printers"
        title="Tìm máy in rảnh"
        icon="search"
        status="done"
        defaultOpen
        input={{ material: "PETG", nozzle: 0.4 }}
        output={[{ id: "x1c-03", name: "X1 Carbon 03", queue: 0 }]}
      />
      <ToolCall name="slice_model" title="Cắt lớp mô hình" icon="layers" status="running" input={{ file: "gia-do.stl", layer: 0.2 }} />
      <ToolCall name="upload_gcode" title="Gửi G-code tới máy in" icon="upload" status="error" error="Máy in đang offline." input={{ printer: "x1c-03" }} />
      <ToolCall name="notify" title="Báo khách hàng" icon="bell" status="pending" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ToolCall

One tool the agent called: a row with its name and status that opens to show the input (arguments) and the output.
Strings show as they are, anything else as formatted JSON; `error` shows in place of the output.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `string` |  | The tool's id ("search_files"). |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | What it does in words ("Tìm tệp cấu hình"); the row shows it instead of the name. |
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"wrench"` |  |
| `status` * | `'pending' \| 'running' \| 'done' \| 'error' \| 'awaiting'` |  |  |
| `input` | `unknown` |  | Arguments: a string or any JSON value. |
| `output` | `unknown` |  | Result: a string or any JSON value. |
| `error` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Error message when status is "error". |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Anything else under the output (a preview, an ActionConfirmation). |

## Accessibility

- The row is a disclosure button; status is text in the badge, not colour only; an error is role="alert".

## Notes

- Give title in words (“Tìm máy in rảnh”); name (the tool id) shows inside.
- Put an ActionConfirmation inside (children) when the call waits for approval.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/tool-call/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/agent-run.md -->

# Agent workspace

A full agent turn composed from the AI parts: the request, reasoning, a plan, tool calls, an approval, the answer with sources and a composer with the context meter. Copy it with `semi add agent-run`.

## When to use

- Starting an agent chat or run log; shows how the AI parts sit together in a ChatList; the AI doc pages link here.

## Examples

### One agent turn

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ActionConfirmation, AssistantMessage, ChatComposer, ContextMeter, Reasoning, Sources, TaskList, ToolCall, UserMessage } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AgentRunTurn() {
  const [ok, setOk] = useState<"pending" | "approved" | "rejected">("pending");
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="flex h-[640px] flex-col bg-panel">
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-4 p-4">
        <UserMessage>Xếp lịch in 20 giá đỡ PETG cho đơn #1042 và báo khách.</UserMessage>
        <Reasoning duration={3}>Cần một máy in rảnh có PETG, ước lượng thời gian rồi gửi email cho khách.</Reasoning>
        <TaskList
          title="Kế hoạch"
          steps={[
            { label: "Tìm máy in rảnh", status: "done" },
            { label: "Ước lượng thời gian in", status: "done" },
            { label: "Gửi email cho khách", status: ok === "approved" ? "done" : ok === "rejected" ? "skipped" : "running" },
          ]}
        />
        <ToolCall name="search_printers" title="Tìm máy in rảnh" icon="search" status="done" input={{ material: "PETG" }} output={[{ id: "x1c-03", queue: 0 }]} />
        <ToolCall name="estimate" title="Ước lượng thời gian" icon="clock" status="done" output="20 bản · 6 giờ 40 phút" />
        <ToolCall name="send_email" title="Gửi email cho khách" icon="send" status={ok === "pending" ? "awaiting" : ok === "approved" ? "done" : "error"} error="Bạn đã từ chối." defaultOpen>
          <ActionConfirmation title="Gửi email cho an@example.com?" icon="send" state={ok} onApprove={() => setOk("approved")} onReject={() => setOk("rejected")}>
            “Đơn #1042 sẽ in xong lúc 17:40 hôm nay.”
          </ActionConfirmation>
        </ToolCall>
        {ok !== "pending" && (
          <AssistantMessage actions={<Sources sources={[{ title: "Lịch máy in", href: "https://example.com/schedule" }]} />}>
            Đã xếp đơn #1042 vào X1 Carbon 03, xong lúc 17:40{ok === "approved" ? " và đã báo khách." : ". Chưa gửi email cho khách."}
          </AssistantMessage>
        )}
      </div>
      <ChatComposer value={draft} onChange={setDraft} onSend={() => setDraft("")} toolbar={<ContextMeter used={48_200} total={200_000} />} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

## Accessibility

- Order follows what happened; only the answer text is announced (ChatList), tool and reasoning details stay behind disclosures.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/agent-run/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/dashboard.md -->

# Dashboard

An overview page: title, KPI row with trends, a revenue chart, orders by status and the latest orders. Copy it with `semi add dashboard`, then replace the sample data.

## When to use

- The home page of an admin or operations app: a few numbers, one trend, what needs attention.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A page that is mostly one list | the List page block |

## Examples

### Overview

```tsx
"use client";

import { Badge, BarChart, Card, DonutChart, Item, ItemGroup, KpiCard, PageTitle, Sparkline } from "@semi/ui";

const WEEKS = ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7", "T8"].map((w, i) => ({ week: w, online: 22 + i * 3 + (i % 3) * 4, store: 14 + i * 2 - (i % 2) * 3 }));
const LATEST = [
  { id: "SO-1062", customer: "Nguyễn An", total: "1.240.000 ₫", status: ["emerald", "Đã giao"] },
  { id: "SO-1061", customer: "Trần Bình", total: "380.000 ₫", status: ["sky", "Đang in"] },
  { id: "SO-1060", customer: "Lê Chi", total: "2.150.000 ₫", status: ["amber", "Chờ thanh toán"] },
] as const;

export default function DashboardPage() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageTitle title="Tổng quan" />
      <div className="grid gap-3 grid-cols-2 @3xl:grid-cols-4">
        <KpiCard label="Doanh thu tuần" value="61,8 tr ₫" sub="+12% so với tuần trước" tone="good" icon="coin" iconTone="green" />
        <KpiCard label="Đơn mới" value="148" sub="+9 so với tuần trước" tone="good" icon="receipt" iconTone="sky" />
        <KpiCard label="Máy đang chạy" value="11/14" icon="printer" iconTone="violet" />
        <KpiCard label="Tỉ lệ lỗi" value="1,8%" sub="-0,4 điểm" tone="good" icon="alert" iconTone="pink" />
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-3 @4xl:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]">
        <Card className="p-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <h2 className="text-title font-medium text-contrast">Doanh thu theo kênh</h2>
            <Sparkline label="Tổng doanh thu 8 tuần" values={WEEKS.map((w) => w.online + w.store)} />
          </div>
          <BarChart
            stacked
            label="Doanh thu theo kênh, 8 tuần (triệu ₫)"
            data={WEEKS}
            index="week"
            series={[
              { key: "online", label: "Online" },
              { key: "store", label: "Cửa hàng" },
            ]}
            format={(v) => `${v} tr ₫`}
          />
        </Card>
        <Card className="p-4 space-y-3">
          <h2 className="text-title font-medium text-contrast">Đơn theo trạng thái</h2>
          <DonutChart
            label="Đơn theo trạng thái"
            centerLabel="Tổng đơn"
            data={[
              { label: "Đã giao", value: 812 },
              { label: "Đang in", value: 164 },
              { label: "Chờ thanh toán", value: 96 },
            ]}
          />
        </Card>
      </div>
      <ItemGroup label="Đơn mới nhất" showLabel>
        {LATEST.map((o) => (
          <Item key={o.id} icon="receipt" title={o.id} description={o.customer} meta={<span className="tabular-nums">{o.total}</span>} actions={<Badge tone={o.status[0]} dot size="sm">{o.status[1]}</Badge>} href={`#${o.id}`} />
        ))}
      </ItemGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

## Accessibility

- One h1 (PageTitle); every chart has a table view; KPI trends say “so với tuần trước” in text, not colour only.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/dashboard/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/list-page.md -->

# List page

A records page: title, toolbar (status pills, search, refresh, add), a data table that sorts, selects and pages, bulk actions. Copy it with `semi add list-page`.

## When to use

- Orders, customers, products, jobs: any page whose job is to find and act on records.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Entities people recognise by image and status | a grid of Card |

## Examples

### Orders

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge, Button, DataTable, PageTitle, Pills, SubpageToolbar, toast, type DataTableColumn } from "@semi/ui";

type Order = { id: string; customer: string; status: "paid" | "pending" | "refunded"; total: number; date: string };
const STATUS = { paid: ["emerald", "Đã thanh toán"], pending: ["amber", "Chờ xử lý"], refunded: ["rose", "Hoàn tiền"] } as const;
const ORDERS: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `SO-${1040 + i}`,
  customer: ["Nguyễn An", "Trần Bình", "Lê Chi", "Phạm Dũng", "Hoàng Hà", "Võ Lan"][i % 6],
  status: (["paid", "pending", "paid", "refunded"] as const)[i % 4],
  total: 180_000 + ((i * 97_000) % 2_400_000),
  date: `2026-10-${String(1 + (i % 28)).padStart(2, "0")}`,
}));

const COLUMNS: DataTableColumn<Order>[] = [
  { key: "id", header: "Mã đơn", sortable: true, cell: (o) => <span className="font-medium text-contrast">{o.id}</span> },
  { key: "customer", header: "Khách hàng", sortable: true },
  { key: "status", header: "Trạng thái", value: (o) => STATUS[o.status][1], cell: (o) => <Badge tone={STATUS[o.status][0]} dot>{STATUS[o.status][1]}</Badge> },
  { key: "date", header: "Ngày", sortable: true },
  { key: "total", header: "Tổng", sortable: true, numeric: true, cell: (o) => `${o.total.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫` },
];

export default function ListPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const rows = status === "all" ? ORDERS : ORDERS.filter((o) => o.status === status);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageTitle title="Đơn hàng" />
      <SubpageToolbar
        left={
          <Pills
            value={status}
            onChange={setStatus}
            options={[
              { key: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
              { key: "pending", label: "Chờ xử lý" },
              { key: "paid", label: "Đã thanh toán" },
              { key: "refunded", label: "Hoàn tiền" },
            ]}
          />
        }
        searchValue={q}
        onSearchChange={setQ}
        searchPlaceholder="Tìm mã đơn, khách hàng…"
        onRefresh={() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600))}
        onPrimaryAction={() => toast({ title: "Tạo đơn mới" })}
        primaryActionLabel="Tạo đơn"
      />
      <DataTable
        label="Đơn hàng"
        rows={rows}
        columns={COLUMNS}
        getRowId={(o) => o.id}
        search={q}
        defaultSort={{ key: "date", dir: "desc" }}
        selectable
        bulkActions={(ids) => (
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" icon="download" onClick={() => toast({ title: `Đã xuất ${ids.length} đơn` })}>
            Xuất CSV
          </Button>
        )}
        pageSize={10}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

## Accessibility

- Filters and search sit above the table they filter; the table has a caption; bulk actions appear as a labelled region.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/list-page/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/settings-page.md -->

# Settings page

A settings page: sections of rows with switches and links, a profile form with validation and one save action, and a danger zone. Copy it with `semi add settings-page`.

## When to use

- Account, workspace or device settings.

## Examples

### Workspace settings

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Card, confirmDialog, CustomSelect, Field, Input, Item, ItemGroup, PageTitle, Switch, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("Xưởng in A");
  const [lang, setLang] = useState("vi");
  const [notify, setNotify] = useState(true);
  const [digest, setDigest] = useState(false);
  const error = name.trim().length < 3 ? "Tên cần ít nhất 3 ký tự." : undefined;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageTitle title="Cài đặt" />
      <Card className="p-4 space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-title font-medium text-contrast">Không gian làm việc</h2>
        <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Tên" required error={error}>
            <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Ngôn ngữ">
            <CustomSelect
              variant="field"
              value={lang}
              onChange={setLang}
              options={[
                { value: "vi", label: "Tiếng Việt" },
                { value: "en", label: "English" },
              ]}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <Button variant="primary" disabled={Boolean(error)} onClick={() => toast({ title: "Đã lưu", tone: "success" })}>
            Lưu
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
      <ItemGroup label="Thông báo" showLabel>
        <Item icon="bell" title="Khi in xong hoặc lỗi" description="Gửi tới ứng dụng và email" actions={<Switch checked={notify} onChange={setNotify} label={<span className="sr-only">Khi in xong hoặc lỗi</span>} />} />
        <Item icon="fileText" title="Báo cáo tuần" description="Thứ Hai, 8:00" actions={<Switch checked={digest} onChange={setDigest} label={<span className="sr-only">Báo cáo tuần</span>} />} />
        <Item icon="key" title="Khoá API" description="Cho tích hợp và agent" href="#api-keys" />
      </ItemGroup>
      <Card className="p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-title font-medium text-contrast">Xoá không gian làm việc</h2>
          <p className="text-label text-muted">Xoá mọi máy in, đơn và lịch sử. Không thể khôi phục.</p>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="danger"
          icon="trash"
          onClick={async () => {
            if (await confirmDialog({ title: "Xoá Xưởng in A?", message: "Mọi dữ liệu sẽ bị xoá vĩnh viễn.", confirmLabel: "Xoá", tone: "danger" })) toast({ title: "Đã xoá", tone: "danger" });
          }}
        >
          Xoá
        </Button>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

## Accessibility

- Each section is a labelled ItemGroup; fields use Field (label, hint, error wired); the destructive action asks first (confirmDialog).

<!-- docs/components/locale.md -->

# Locale

SemiLocaleProvider sets the UI strings of every Semi component (Vietnamese by default, English shipped, override any string).

## When to use

- An app in English, or one that renames a built-in label.

## Import

```tsx
import { SemiLocaleProvider, en, vi, useSemiLocale } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### English

```tsx
"use client";

import { Menu, SemiLocaleProvider, en, useSemiLocale } from "@semi/ui";

function Probe() {
  const t = useSemiLocale();
  return (
    <span className="text-label text-muted">
      close = <span className="text-contrast">{t.close}</span> · search = <span className="text-contrast">{t.search}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

export default function LocaleEnglish() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <Probe />
      <SemiLocaleProvider locale={en}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Probe />
          <Menu items={[{ label: "Rename", icon: "edit", onSelect: () => undefined }]} />
        </div>
      </SemiLocaleProvider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### SemiLocaleProvider

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `locale` * | `Partial<SemiStrings>` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Button labels, aria-labels and announcements all come from the locale.

<!-- docs/components/theme.md -->

# Theme

Light / dark / system: ThemeScript applies the stored theme before paint, ThemeProvider keeps it, ThemeSwitcher (three-way) and ThemeToggle switch it. data-theme on any element re-scopes every token inside it.

## When to use

- Once in every app's root layout; the switcher in settings or the sidebar footer.

## Import

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, ThemeScript, ThemeSwitcher, ThemeToggle, useTheme, themeScript } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Switchers

```tsx
"use client";

import { ThemeSwitcher, ThemeToggle, useTheme } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ThemeSwitchers() {
  const { theme, resolvedTheme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      <ThemeSwitcher showLabels />
      <ThemeSwitcher />
      <ThemeToggle />
      <span className="text-label text-muted tabular-nums">
        theme = {theme} · resolved = {resolvedTheme}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Scoped theme

data-theme on a wrapper fixes the theme of everything inside it.

```tsx
import { Badge, Button, Card } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ThemeScope() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      {(["light", "dark"] as const).map((t) => (
        <div key={t} data-theme={t} className="rounded-card border border-line bg-canvas p-3">
          <Card className="p-3 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-ui font-semibold text-contrast">data-theme="{t}"</span>
              <Badge tone="emerald" dot>
                Online
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <Button variant="primary" icon="check">
              Lưu
            </Button>
          </Card>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Root layout

```tsx
import { ConfirmHost, ThemeProvider, ThemeScript, ToastHost } from "@semi/ui";

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="vi" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <ThemeScript />
      </head>
      <body className="bg-canvas text-body">
        <ThemeProvider>
          {children}
          <ToastHost />
          <ConfirmHost />
        </ThemeProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

## API

### ThemeProvider

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `defaultTheme` | `'light' \| 'dark' \| 'system'` | `"dark"` |  |
| `storageKey` | `string` | `"semi-theme"` |  |
| `attribute` | `string` | `"data-theme"` |  |

### ThemeScript

Render inside <head> of the root layout, with the same options as ThemeProvider:
  <html lang="vi" suppressHydrationWarning><head><ThemeScript /></head><body><ThemeProvider>…

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultTheme` | `'light' \| 'dark' \| 'system'` |  |  |
| `storageKey` | `string` |  |  |
| `attribute` | `string` |  |  |

### ThemeSwitcher

Three-way theme picker (Sáng · Tối · Hệ thống) for settings pages and sidebar footers. ThemeToggle is the one-tap dark/light flip.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the text label next to each icon (default: icons only, label in the tooltip). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch to the container width (sidebar footers, settings rows). |
| `labels` | `Record<Theme, string>` |  | Override the labels (default: the SemiLocaleProvider strings). |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

### ThemeToggle

Theme toggle button: seamlessly switches between Dark and Light mode.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `"md"` |  |

## Accessibility

- ThemeSwitcher is a radio group; nothing is marked selected until the stored theme is known (no flash).
